event_description: On 1 January 2021, a Niger militia kidnapped 3 girls in Barakuta village, coded to Maikonkele (Bosso, Niger).
On 1 January 2021, an armed group clashed with a local self defence militia in Okporo community, Rumuodomaya (Obio, Rivers). An unspecified number of people were injured.
On 1 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with a Zamfara communal militia at Tungar Ruwa (Anka LGA, Zamfara), rescuing three kidnapped victims.
On 1 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked Nisama village (Jema'a LGA, Kaduna) and abducted two residents. One reported fatality. Unknown reason for attack.
On 1 January 2021, an armed group abducted 2 people in Abaji (Abaji, Federal Capital Territory).

Around 1 January 2021 (as reported), an unidentified cult group shot and killed a commercial bus driver along Siluko road in Benin City (Oredo, Edo). The cult militia had boarded the bus before it was diverted to where the driver was killed.
On 2 January 2021, unidentified gunmen abducted a male doctor in Tapa (Ibarapa North LGA, Oyo). Reason for abduction unknown.
On 2 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked and killed three people including a business woman at Idere (Ibarapa Central LGA, Oyo). Unknown reason for attack.
On 2 January 2021, an armed group killed 1 person and abducted another along the Idere road, in or around Igbo Ora (Ibarapa Central, Oyo).
On 2 January 2021, an Amotekun member shot and killed a police officer during a carnival in the Sanga area of Oyo (Oyo West, Oyo). Motivation for the attack was unknown/not reported.
On 2 January 2021, the Aye and Eiye cult militias clashed and killed a rival member in Isale Osun, Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun), in a renewed supremacy clash. One person was killed.

On 2 January 2021, a Kaduna communal militia clashed with a local communal militia at Kaya Village (Giwa LGA), killing at least 14 residents, including the head of the local militia group. The attack was a reprisal attack after local militiamen abducted and killed one of their members.

Around 2 January 2021 (between 1 January - 2 January), unidentified cult militias clashed and shot dead two militiamembers at the Adolor College area in Ugbowo (Egor, Edo) as part of the continued supremacy clash in the city. 2 fatalities reported.

On 2 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with a Katsina Communal Militia at Garin Garus (Batsari LGA, Katsina), killing five militiamen and recovering weapons and ammunition. One military officer was also killed and two were injured.

On 2 January 2021, ISWAP abducted 50 passengers, including a Senior Protection Assistant with the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), along the Damaturu-Maiduguri Road, around Jakana (Bama, Borno).The kidnapped UNHCR representative was later released.

Around 2 January 2021, a Kaduna communal militia shot and killed the Chief imam at his residence in Kawaran Rafi village (Igabi LGA, Kaduna). Reason for attack related to the Chief Imam's stance against the killing and kidnapping of people by communal militias.
Around 2 January 2021 (between 1 - 3 January), two unidentified cult gangs clashed amongst each other in Benin City (Oredo, Edo). 5 people were killed.

On 2 January 2021, Nigerian Police forces clashed with a Zamfara communal militia at the outskirts of Shinkafi LGA (Zamfara) after receiving a distress call about their kidnapping activities. One Kidnapped victim rescued. No reported fatalities.
On 3 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked Peremabiri community (Southern Ijaw LGA, Bayelsa). Property damage reported. Unknown reason for attack. No reported fatalities.
On 3 January 2021, Aiye (Black Axe) and Eiye confraternities clashed in the Igbogbo and Bayeku areas, Imeko-Afon LGA (Ogun), coded to Igbogbo. 2 people were killed.
On 3 January 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and killed a pastoralist in Matyei village in Atyap Chiefdom (Zango-Kataf LGA, Kaduna). Event related to farmer-pastoralist conflicts.

On 3 January 2021, a Kaduna communal militia attacked motorists at Zankoro along Birnin-Gwari-Kaduna highway (Birnin-Gwari LGA, Kaduna), killing nine and abducting an unspecified number of passengers. Unknown reason for attack.
On 3 January 2021, unidentified gunmen shot and killed a male hairstylist by Otite Road Junction in Sapele (Sapele LGA, Delta). Unknown reason for attack.

On 3 January 2021, an unidentified cult militia shot and killed a member of their rival group in Ahunwan Street, Ugbowo (Egor, Edo), in a renewed cult killing in the city. The victim was gunned down a few meters away from his home on a visit to a friend's residence. 1 fatality reported.
On 3 January 2021, Boko Haram elements attacked Kaumutuyahi village (Chibok LGA, Borno), killing many residents. Property damage also reported. Unknown fatalities coded as 10.
On 3 January 2021, Boko Haram militants attacked a military base in Kuda (Nganzai LGA, Borno), killing no fewer than six soldiers. Property damage also reported.

On 3 January 2021, Boko Haram militants attacked Kwada (Chibok LGA, Borno), setting several houses ablaze. Nigerian military forces tried to repel the attack, but were overpowered. At least six reported fatalities.

On 3 January 2021, an armed group clashed with presumed military officers as they were attacking commuters in Gidan Gambo, along the Lafia-Shandam road, Lafia LGA (Nassarawa), coded to Lafia. One armed individual was killed and the others fled with injuries.

Around 3 January 2021 (between 3 - 4 January), an unidentified armed group invaded the residence of the Councilor representing Gwako ward in Gwagwalada LGA (Federal Capital Territory), kidnapping five, including the two wives of the Councilor. The victims were released on 9 January, after the payment of ransom.

On 3 January 2021, the Aye and Eiye cult militias clashed and killed two of their members in the Igbogbo Bayeku areas of Ikorodu, Baiyeku (Ikorodu, Lagos). The fight ensued when a cult group rode on motorcycles, attacked the rival group at a party and killed one of them. The killing led to a reprisal attack on the assailant, who also lost a member. 2 casualties were reported.

Around 3 January 2021 (between 1 January - 3 January), two unidentified rival cult groups clashed and killed two members in Oluku (Ovia North East, Edo) in the renewed supremacy battle in the area. 2 fatalities reported.
On 4 January 2021, unidentified gunmen abducted a pastor and three others at Ogwashi Uku (Aniocha South LGA, Delta). Victims were later released. Unclear whether ransom was paid.
On 4 January 2021, an armed group killed a hunter at the Delta State Fire Service Station in Abo Ogwashi-Uku (Aniocha South, Delta). The hunter's gun was taken.
On 4 January 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked civilians in Dan Kungi, Birnin Gwari LGA (Kaduna), coded to Birnin Gwari. 6 people were injured and 11 were abducted.

On 4 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with Kaduna communal militias at Birnin Gwari, Giwa, Igabi, and Chikun Local Government Areas in Kaduna State, killing an unspecified number of militiamen. Unknown fatalities coded as 3 and split across 4 events.

On 4 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with Kaduna communal militias at Birnin Gwari, Giwa, Igabi, and Chikun Local Government Areas in Kaduna State, killing an unspecified number of militiamen. Unknown fatalities coded as 3 and split across 4 events.
On 4 January 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists abducted a farmer at Oke Agbede in Igangan (Ibarapa North LGA, Oyo). Reason for abduction unknown.

Around 4 January 2021 (as reported), unidentified gunmen associated with the Minister of Transport attacked APC supporters in Buguma (Asari-Toru LGA, Rivers) over their disagreement with the Minister. Reported injuries.

On 4 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked motorists along Gadabuke/ Toto Road (Toto LGA, Nasarawa), killing the former Nasarawa Education Secretary and kidnapping 20 other passengers. Police sources report one fatality and denied that any passengers were abducted.

On 4 January 2021, an armed group abducted a couple along the Owo-Akure road, in or around Uso community, Owo LGA (Ondo), coded to Owo. A ransom was demanded and the police rescued the victims on 9 January, arresting the group.

On 4 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with Kaduna communal militias at Birnin Gwari, Giwa, Igabi, and Chikun Local Government Areas in Kaduna State, killing an unspecified number of militiamen. Unknown fatalities coded as 3 and split across 4 events.

On 4 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with Kaduna communal militias at Birnin Gwari, Giwa, Igabi, and Chikun Local Government Areas in Kaduna State, killing an unspecified number of militiamen. Unknown fatalities coded as 3 and split across 4 events.

On 5 January 2021, two unidentified rival cult groups clashed and killed two militiamen in Ejigbo (Ejigbo, Osun), and another militiaman was killed in the Sabo area in Oshogbo (coded separately). 2 fatalities reported.
Around 5 January 2021 (as reported), Nigerian security forces clashed with unidentified gunmen along Asi-Oyan road (Ila LGA, Osun), rescuing six kidnapped victims.

On 5 January 2021, two unidentified rival cult groups clashed and killed a militiaman in the Sabo area in Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun) and a militiaman was killed in Ejigbo (coded separately). 1 fatality reported.
On 5 January 2021, Boko Haram elements attacked Wamdeo and Chul communities (Askira LGA, Borno) but were repelled by Nigerian military troops. Property damage reported. No reported fatalities.

On 5 January 2021, Boko Haram fighters attacked a military base in Sabon Gari (Hawul LGA, Borno) but were repelled by Nigerian military troops. Reported casualties and weapons recovered from Boko Haram fighters.
On 5 January 2021, 2 people were killed by an armed group in Awo-Idemili (Orsu, Imo).
On 5 January 2021, ISWAP ambushed Nigerian troops near Monguno (Monguno LGA, Borno), killing and wounding a number of soldiers. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 5 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked and shot the brother of the APC South-South Zonal Youth Leader in Benin City (Oredo LGA, Edo). Attack may be connected to the Zonal Youth Leader's testimony against Governor Godwin Obaseki.
On 6 January 2021, a Niger communal militia invaded Rigo Village (Rafi LGA, Niger), abducting five residents. Reason for abduction unknown.
On 6 January 2021, four people were killed in a renewed communal clash between Abankang militia and Alok militia in Ikom LGA (Cross River). This is due to a land dispute.

On 6 January 2021, a Niger communal militia attacked and looted Chukuba (Shiroro LGA, Niger), carting away rustled livestock. Nigerian police forces tried to repel the attack, but were overpowered. One reported fatality.

Around 6 January 2021 (as reported), Nigerian police forces with local hunters clashed with suspected kidnappers along Ila road at Ilesa axis (Ilesha East LGA, Osun), rescuing kidnapped victims and arresting two suspects.

On 6 January 2021, an officer of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps assaulted three journalists at the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) in Abuja (Abuja Municipal LGA, FCT) over their coverage of events at the NIMC headquarters. No reported casualties.

On 6 January 2021, ISWAP clashed with Nigerian military troops in Geidam (Geidam LGA, Yobe) after attacking the town and abducting the district head. Property damage additionally reported. ISWAP sources report several soldiers were killed and wounded and weapons and ammunition seized.

On 6 January 2021, ISWAP militants allegedly repelled an attack from the Nigerian army in Gujeri (Konduga LGA, Borno), killing a number of soldiers and destroying three armored vehicles and a number motorcycles. Unknown fatalities coded as 10.
On 6 January 2021, ISWAP ambushed Nigerian military troops on the road between the towns of Bosso and Malam Fatori (Abadam LGA, Borno), killing at least one soldier.

On 6 January 2021, Boko Haram militants attacked commuters at Aligambori near Gajiram along the Maiduguri-Monguno Road (Nganzai LGA, Borno), killing passengers and seizing 11 vehicles. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 7 January 2021, ISWAP militants clashed with Nigerian military troops at the army checkpoint in Gajiram (Nganzai LGA, Borno), allegedly killing a number of soldiers. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 7 January 2021, ISWAP militants ambushed Nigerian military troops on the road between Maiduguri (Maiduguri LGA, Borno) and Mafa (Mafa LGA, Borno), allegedly killing and wounding a number of soldiers. Unknown fatalities coded as 10.
On 7 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with na armed group at Mararaba Udege in Nasarawa LGA (Nasarawa), killing one militiaman and rescuing three kidnapped victims.

On 7 January 2021, a Kaduna communal militia abducted an unspecified number of female residents in Katarma Village (Chikun LGA, Kaduna) but were repelled by military troops and local militiamen. Four reported fatalities.

On 8 January 2021, Fulani pastoralists sexually assaulted and injured a female farmer at Keana LGA (Nasarawa). The attack was a reprisal after the assaulted victim's brother refused for pastoralists to graze on his farmland.

On 8 January 2021, a Zamfara communal militia attacked and looted Dada Village in Dan Sadau (Maru LGA, Zamfara), killing scores of residents and carting away rustled livestock. Scores of fatalities coded as 20.
On 8 January 2021, unidentified gunmen clashed with Nigerian police officers in Onueke (Ezza South LGA, Ebonyi), killing three. Gunmen also set the station and four vehicles ablaze.
On 8 January 2021, Boko Haram militants attacked Ngumari Village near Moromti (Konduga LGA, Borno), killing three and injuring one other resident.
On 8 January 2021, ISWAP militants attacked Ngurbuwa village (Gujba LGA, Yobe). No reported casualties.
On 8 January 2021, ISWAP clashed with Nigerian troops at Tungushe (Jere LGA, Borno), killing and wounding a number of soldiers. Unknown fatalities coded as 10.

On 8 January 2021, a Zamfara communal militia attacked Kadauri Village (Maru LGA, Zamfara), killing one and kidnapping seven residents, including the six children of the chairman of APC in Zamfara. Militiamen demanded ransom.
On 8 January 2021, two unidentified cult gangs clashed amongst each other in the Ijokodo area, Ibadan North LGA (Oyo), coded to Agodi. 1 person was killed.
On 9 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked and killed a Nigerian Saudi Arabia-based oil expert at his residence in Idah (Idah LGA, Kogi). Unknown reason for attack.
On 9 January 2021, an unidentified cult group shot and killed a member of the Black Axe in Ijebu Imushin (Ijebu East, Ogun). They cut off his right arm after killing him. 1 casualty was reported.

On 9 January 2021, Nigerian military troops shot at motorists at Kyamsagi village in Dengi (Kanam LGA, Plateau), killing one and injuring three passengers. Sources report that victims were suspected to be kidnappers.
On 9 January 2021, Amotekun operatives with MACBAN members clashed with unidentified armed men at Ayete (Ibarapa North LGA, Oyo), killing three.

On 9 January 2021, unidentified gunmen associated with an unreported political party attacked APC members, including a state senator, at a political meeting in Ikire (Irewole LGA, Osun). Property damage reported. No reported fatalities. Unknown reason for attack.
On 9 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked a rice mill factory in Kano State, killing one person. Unknown reason for attack.
On 9 January 2021, Islamic State militants launched a rocket attack against a Nigerian army convoy in Gazagana village near Damaturu LGA (Yobe), killing thirteen soldiers.

On 9 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with ISWAP elements at Gujba LGA (Yobe) following an attack on Gujba town. Multiple fatality reports. Military sources report 28 militants killed and weapons and ammunition recovered, including one gun truck. ISWAP sources also reported that 5 soldiers were killed in the clash and weapons and ammunition seized. Military sources acknowldeged the death of one soldier. Property damage additionally reported.

On 9 January 2021, ISWAP ambushed Nigerian troops between Maiduguri (Maiduguri LGA, Borno) and Mafa (Mafa LGA, Borno), allegedly killing a number of soldiers and seizing weapons and ammunition. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 9 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with Boko Haram elements at Gonan Kaji Village along Damaturu-Buni Yadi Road (Gujba LGA, Yobe), killing 30 militants and recovering weapons and ammunition.
Around 9 January 2021 (as reported), militiamen from a neighboring state attacked Kamaru village (Kauru LGA, Kaduna), killing three residents and injuring another. Unknown reason for attack.
On 10 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with a Katsina Communal Militia at Unguwar Rimi (Rimi LGA, Katsina). Six reported fatalities.
On 10 January 2021, an armed group kidnapped 18 commuters along the Lokoja-Auchi road, Etsako West LGA (Edo), coded to Auchi. A N25 million naira ransom was demanded.
On 10 January 2021, unidentified gunmen clashed with Nigerian police forces at the East-West Road in Ughelli (Ughelli North LGA, Delta), killing three policemen.

On 10 January 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with police officers in Ughelli (Ughelli North, Delta). 3 police officers were killed. The police officers were guarding a hotel and were shot at close range.

On 10 January 2021, ISWAP clashed with Nigerian military troops following a SVBIED attack at Kafa (Damboa LGA, Borno), allegedly killing at least 5 soldiers and injuring 11 others. Military sources also report that 6 militants were neutralized and a gun truck and several weapons as well as equipment belonging to ISWAP destroyed.
On 10 January 2021, ISWAP clashed with Nigerian troops in Marte (Marte LGA, Borno), killing 3 soldiers and seizing weapons and ammunition.

Around 10 January 2021 (as reported), unidentified gunmen attacked a pastor and his driver along Ise-Isua road (Akoko North East LGA, Ondo), killing the driver and abducting the pastor. Victim was later released. Unclear whether ransom was paid.
On 10 January 2021, an armed group kidnapped a businessman at a filling station near the Odo-Ado Divisional Police Headquarters, Ado-Ekiti (Ado Ekiti, was demanded.

On 10 January 2021, military forces clashed with Katsina militiamen during a clearance operation in the Mai Gora area (Faskari, Katsina). 5 militiamen were killed and an unspecified number were injured.
On 10 January 2021, an armed group shot and killed two men on a motorcycle after blocking the Ross - Rim road, Riyom LGA (Plateau), coded to Rim.

Around 10 January 2021 (as reported), Nigerian military forces clashed with a Zamfara Communal Militia at Kuriya (Kaura Namoda LGA, Zamfara), killing at least 50 militiamen and recovering 272 livestock.

Around 11 January 2021 (between 11 - 12 January), a Kaduna militia killed two people and injured two others between Bakin Kogi (Jema'a LGA, Kaduna) and Narido village (Kauru LGA, Kaduna). Unknown reason for attack.
On 11 January 2021, an armed group kidnapped a businessman along the Amawbia-Igbariam Road, in Anambra East LGA (Anambra), coded to Igbariam.
On 11 January 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked and injured a woman on the Oru-Awa Road (Ijebu North LGA, Ogun). Event connected to farmer-pastoralist conflict. Three suspects arrested.
On 12 January 2021, unidentified gunmen abducted a lecturer at his residence in Igwurtali (Ikwerre LGA, Rivers). Reason for abduction unknown.
On 12 January 2021, two cult militias clashed in Badagry (Badagry, Lagos). 1 person was killed.

On 12 January 2021, an unidentified cult militia/gang attacked residents and destroyed properties in Ota-Efun / Otaefum area (Olorunda, Osun) over allegations that the residents were responsible for the death of their leader. No fatalities.

On 12 January 2021, unidentified gunmen associated with a member of the Ebonyi State House of Assembly attacked PDP members at a political meeting in Umuezeoka Ezza Ntezi (Ishielu LGA, Ebonyi). Property damage reported. No reported fatalities. Unknown reason for attack.
On 12 January 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked and killed a farmer near Boole village in Ijabe area (Odo Otin LGA, Osun). Event connected to farmer-pastoralist conflicts.
On 12 January 2021, Yansakai Militia attacked and killed a Fulani Pastoralist at Talata Mafara LGA (Zamfara). Unknown reason for attack.

On 12 January 2021, seven unidentified cult militias attacked and assaulted a man in Port Harcourt (Port Harcourt, Rivers) after having an altercation with one of their members while queuing for national identity card registration. The armed militia dispossessed him of his phone and money, and the ensuing commotion disrupted the registration exercise.
On 12 January 2021, a Niger Communal Militia attacked Erena town (Shiroro LGA, Niger), but were repelled by Nigerian security forces and local militiamen. No reported fatalities.

On 12 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with ISWAP fighters following a suicide bomb attack at Talala village in Borno State. Six reported soldiers and dozens of militants were reportedly killed. Fatalities coded as 18.
On 13 January 2021, a Kaduna Communal Militia invaded and looted Mando (Birnin-Gwari LGA, Kaduna), carting away grains and other food items and abducting 18 residents. Reason for abduction unknown.
On 13 January 2021, an armed group attacked commuters between Obbo Aiyegunle and Omu Aran in Irepodun LGA (Kwara). 1 person was injured and another person was abducted.

On 13 January 2021, the Black Axe and the Eiye cult militias clashed and killed two militiamen in Iworoko-Ekiti, Iworoko (Irepodun, Ekiti). The clash lasted two hours before the police intervened. Five militiamen were arrested and arraigned in court. 2 fatalities reported.

On 13 January 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar attack against Nigerian troops in Kafa (Damboa LGA, Borno) and also claimed an IED attack against Nigerian troops in the same area. Several soldiers reportedly killed and 2 APC vehicles destroyed. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 13 January 2021, presumed Boko Haram/ISWAP used a RPG to attack Gajiram (Nganzai, Borno). 2 people were abducted, including a district head; a telecommunications mast and a vehicle were destroyed.
On 13 January 2021, a Sokoto Communal Militia attacked Zamia Village in Sokoto State, killing seven and injuring another seven residents.

Around 13 January 2021 (as reported), unidentified gunmen attacked three PDP councillorship candidates near Asaba (Oshimili South LGA, Delta) in light of the upcoming local government elections, killing one and abducting the other two.
On 13 January 2021, a Kaduna Communal Militia attacked Garu village (Igabi LGA, Kaduna), killing two residents. Unknown reason for attack.

On 13 January 2021, unidentified gunmen associated with the Anambra state government abducted a former commissioner in Awka (Awka South LGA, Anambra) over his disagreement with the state government on corruption-related matters.
On 13 January 2021, Amotekun operatives fired indiscriminately in the Mokola area of Ibadan (Ibadan North West, Oyo). 1 person was killed by a stray bullet.

Around 13 January 2021 (as reported), Nigerian military troops clashed with a Kaduna Communal Militia along Gwagwada general area (Chikun LGA, Kaduna) following an attack on hunters in the area. Military troops also destroyed the militants' camps. One reported fatality.
On 14 January 2021, a Niger Communal Militia abducted no fewer than 20 residents from Madaka (Rafi LGA, Niger). Reason for abduction unknown.
On 14 January 2021, an armed group abducted one person from a residence at Ekpan (Uvwie, Delta). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 14 January 2021, unidentified gunmen abducted a former member of the Bauchi Assembly in the Bauchi metropolis (Bauchi LGA, Bauchi). Victim was later released. Unclear if ransom was paid.
On 14 January 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar and rocket attack against Nigerian troops in Goniri (Gujba LGA, Borno). No reported fatalities.

On 14 January 2021, ISWAP clashed with Nigerian troops and CJTF members at Gajiram (Nganzai LGA, Borno), allegedly killing and wounding a number of soldiers and militiamen and seizing weapons and ammunition. ISWAP also set two vehicles ablaze. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 14 January 2021, unidentified cult groups clashed and killed a rival group member in Ekpri Ikang (Akpabuyo, Cross River) in a supremacy tussle. 1 fatality was reported.

On 14 January 2021, an armed group on motorcycles attacked and killed two persons in Ajibade community, coded to Ibadan (Ibadan North West, Oyo). The attack was suspected to be a reprisal by a gang for the lynching of their member by a mob. Security agents were deployed to the location to restore order.
On 14 January 2021, Boko Haram elements attacked and looted Garin Gada village (Yunusari LGA, Yobe), killing two residents. Property damage additionally reported.

On 15 January 2021, armed Fulani pastoralists attacked four farmers returning home from their farm at Konko village, coded to Igangan (Ibarapa North, Oyo). Two farmers were killed and two were wounded.

Around 15 January 2021 (as reported), Yoruba militiamen in 4 vehicles attacked a Fulani camp at Igangan (Ibarapa North, Oyo) in reprisal for the attack by Fulani militiamen on farmers [coded separately]. Four persons were wounded.
On 15 January 2021, a Katsina militia ambushed and killed five security agents, presumed military, in Marke, Mashi LGA (Katsina). A vehicle belonging to the security agents was set on fire.
On 15 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked Ogila-ama community (Southern Ijaw LGA, Bayelsa). Property damage reported. Unknown reason for attack. No reported fatalities.
On 15 January 2021, a Niger Communal Militia abducted a Catholic priest and his brother at Tufa village along the Lambata-Lapai Road (Lapai LGA, Minna). One reported fatality.
On 15 January 2021, a Kaduna Communal Militia ambushed Nigerian police at Farinruwa Village along the Birnin Gwari- Funtua Road (Birnin-Gwari LGA, Kaduna), killing at least 4 policemen.

On 15 January 2021, an armed group dressed in police uniform abducted a university lecturer at All Seasons Avenue, New Owerri, coded to Uratta (Owerri North, Imo). There are no reports about ransom demands.

Around 15 January 2021 (as reported), Nigerian military troops clashed with Boko Haram elements between Goniri (Gujba LGA, Yobe) and Gorigi (Damboa LGA, Borno), killing several militants and recovering ten gun trucks. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

Around 15 January 2021 (between 15 - 17 January), Nigerian military troops clashed with ISWAP militants following an attack on a military base in Marte (Marte LGA, Borno State). ISWAP sources report seven soldiers were killed with one soldier captured. ISWAP militants also seized weapons and ammunition. Military sources on the other hand report several ISWAP militants were killed and seven militant gun trucks destroyed.

On 15 January 2021, two unidentified cult militias clashed and killed a rival group member in Ekpri Ikang (Akpabuyo, Cross River) in a continuation of the supremacy battle that started a day before. 1 fatality was reported.

On 15 January 2021, a Benue Communal Militia ambushed Nigerian security personnel at Mbalagh (Makurdi LGA, Benue), killing a Livestock Guard and injuring an Agro Ranger. Attack may be connected to the farmer-pastoralist conflict.
Around 15 January 2021 (as reported), unidentified gunmen attacked and killed a farmer and his associate at Chikaji village (Igabi LGA, Kaduna) after attempting to kidnap them.

On 16 January 2021, Aguleri and Umueri Ethnic militias engaged in an armed clash at Anambra East LGA (Anambra) over a land dispute. Local sources report that 2 people were killed. Police sources on the other hand report that nobody was killed. Reported property damage.

On 16 January 2021, a soldier killed 4 civilians and injured 3 others along Baga road, coded to Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno). The attack was a result of an altercation between the soldier and civilians. The soldier was mobbed and beheaded [coded separately].
On 16 January 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar attack against Nigerian troops between Gorigi and Kafa (Damboa LGA, Borno). No reported fatalities
On 16 January 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar attack against Nigerian troops in Kafa (Damboa LGA, Borno). No reported fatalities

On 16 January 2021, unidentified cult groups clashed and killed two militiamembers in Ekpri Ikang (Akpabuyo, Cross River) as a reprisal for killing some of their members in the previous clashes. 2 fatalities were reported.
On 16 January 2021, Yansakai Militia attacked and killed three Fulani Pastoralists in Maradun LGA (Zamfara). Militiamen also rustled livestock. Unknown reason for attack.
Around 16 January 2021 (weekend of), a Niger Communal Militia abducted 17 residents from Marenje, Wongo, and Madagwa in Bassa-Kukoki Ward (Shiroro LGA, Niger). Reason for abduction unknown.

On 16 January 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked and shot a university administrator and his driver along the Ilesa-Akure road (Akure South LGA, Ondo). One reported fatality. Unknown reason for attack.
On 17 January 2021, a Kaduna militia clashed with a local defense militia when they attacked Iyatawa (Giwa, Kaduna). The assailants retreated, 2 defense militiamen were killed.

On 17 January 2021, Eiye and Aye cult militias clashed and killed one of the militiamen in Ifo (Ifo, Ogun) in a supremacy battle. Some militiamen sustained gunshot injuries and the police arrested many of them.

On 17 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with a Zamfara Communal Militia near Janbako Village (Maradun LGA, Zamfara) after receiving a distress call from residents about a reprisal attack. At least 15 were reportedly killed, including 5 militiamen. Yansakai Militia sources report that local militiamen were responsible for death of Zamfara militiamen while government sources report security forces were responsible for the deaths of Zamfara militiamen.
Around 17 January 2021 (as reported), a Kaduna Communal Militia attacked and killed two residents at Dande (Chikun LGA, Kaduna). Unknown reason for attack.

On 17 January 2021, a Kaduna Communal Militia attacked the residence of a university professor in Kuregu community in Zaria (Sabon-Gari LGA, Kaduna), abducting the professor and killing his son. Additional casualties also reported.

On 17 January 2021, unidentified gunmen associated with the Oroki NURTW Branch clashed with police guarding the convoy of the Osun State Governor at Old Garage Park (Osogbo LGA, Osun). Property damage reported. No reported fatalities.
On 17 January 2021, unidentified gunmen abducted two persons along Omoh/Erin-Ijesha road (Ori- Ade LGA, Osun). Victims were later rescued by Amotekun corps operatives and local hunters.
Around 17 January 2021 (as reported), a Kaduna Communal Militia shot at motorists between Fatika and Kidandan (Giwa LGA, Kaduna), killing one and injuring others.

On 17 January 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with a Zamfara Communal Militia at Maje Riverline near Yar-Katsina (Bungudu LGA, Zamfara). Thirty militiamen and one air force personnel reportedly killed. Nigerian troops also recovered livestock.

On 17 January 2021, the Aye cult group clashed with the Aro Bagger Confraternity (Nigeria) and shot their ringleader dead in Ughelli (Ughelli North, Delta). The Bagar leader was notorious for killing and robbery in the area. His killing was a reprisal for the massive killing resulting from the cult clash in the area. 1 casualty was reported.

On 27 June 2021, a militia clashed with the armed forces during an attack on the Gidan Zaki village (Zangon Kataf LGA, Kaduna) [coded Zonkwa]. The group destroyed maize crops and a house, also taking valuables. Casualties unknown.

On 27 June 2021, a group of Muslims were attacked by masquerades in a mosque in Oshogbo (Osogbo LGA, Osun). During the attack, a person was shot and killed and between 9 to 13 were injured. The leader of the masquerade group was arrested.

On 27 June 2021, an unidentified cult group attacked a mobile banking operator in the Gbaemu area of Oshogbo ( Osogbo, Osun) over the suspicion that the man recorded them trying to extort some construction workers. On 27 June 2021, the Nigerian police clashed with an unidentified cult group in the Gbaemu area of Oshogbo ( Osogbo, Osun). The police responded to a distressed call when the cultists attempted to extort some construction workers in the area. The police arrested two militants from the cult group.

Around 27 June 2021 (as reported), the military and police forces clashed with militiamen in the Bungudo LGA (Zamfara) [coded Bungudu]. During the clash, 2 security operatives, a police inspector and a NAF operative were killed.

On 27 June 2021, an unidentified armed group killed a man, abducted his wife and two children along Evwreni-Ughelli section of the East-West road (Ughelli North, Delta). On 27 June 2021, Fulani pastoralists abducted two people along the Nigeria Delta Development Commission (NDDC) Road in Sapele (Sapele LGA, Delta).

On 28 June 2021, the military forces clashed with members of ISWAP/Boko Haram in Ajiri (Mafa LGA, Borno). Several people were killed, barracks burned and weapons captured. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 2 July 2021, ISWAP forces clashed with police officers between Auno and Jakana (Bama LGA, Borno). Between 2 to 4 police officers were killed, and rifles were seized.

Around 3 July 2021 (between 2 - 4 July), members of a militia killed a person in the outskirts of Galadimawa (Giwa LGA, Kaduna).
On 3 July 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with a local militia on the Ologbotsere street (BTC road), Ugbowo (Egor LGA, Edo). A local militiaman was killed.
On 3 July 2021, armed individuals, suspected land grabbers, attacked the village of Isiwu (Ikorodu LGA, Lagos). A person was killed and several were injured.
Around 3 July 2021 (between 2 - 4 July), members of a militia killed two people in Iri station (Kajuru LGA, Kaduna).
On 3 July 2021, a Katsina militia abducted a retired banker from his farm in Sheme (Faskari LGA, Katsina).

On 4 July 2021, gunmen attacked the Ajiya and Yasore villages in Batsari LGA (Katsina) [coded Batsari]. Two people were killed and over 35 cattle were seized.

On 4 July 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack against the military forces in Ashigashiya (Gwoza LGA, Borno). A number of soldiers were wounded and killed. Other sources indicate that 5 militants were killed.

On 5 July 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists kidnapped four people in Esa Odo (Obokun LGA, Osun).

Around 5 July 2021 (between 5 - 6 July), an unidentified number of people were kidnapped by suspected Fulani pastoralists at the Odo-Osun axis near Imesi Ile (Obokun LGA, Osun). The group was later rescued.
On 5 July 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked the Bakundi district (Bali LGA, Taraba) and killed at least 3 people, including the head of the Bakundi district.

On 5 July 2021, gunmen clashed with members of a local militia during an attack on a marble quarry site near Ugya village, Toto LGA (Nasarawa) [coded Toto]. During the clash, a local militiaman died and a marble worker was kidnapped.
On 5 July 2021, members of the Boko Haram clashed with members of a local militia in Damboa (Damboa LGA, Borno). The group also burnt buildings. No reports on injuries or fatalities.
On 5 July 2021, ISWAP clashed with the military forces on the Bama-Pulka road (Gwoza LGA, Borno). A number of soldiers were injured.
On 5 July 2021, ISWAP clashed with members of the CJTF and local militia in Dikwa (Dikwa LGA, Borno). Unknown causalities.

On 5 July 2021, ISWAP clashed with security forces in Firgi, Gwoza LGA (Borno). Unknown causalities.
On 6 July 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists killed four members of the same family in Kibori (Zangon Kataf LGA, Kaduna).
On 6 July 2021, a Niger militia fired against residents of Manta (Rafi LGA, Niger). Casualties unknown.

On 6 July 2021, security operatives and local militia members clashed with suspected Fulani pastoralists near Imesi Ile (Obokun LGA, Osun). A group that had been kidnapped earlier was released. During the clash, one security operative was killed.

On 6 July 2021, a PDP member was kidnapped by unidentified individuals along the Benin-Abraka road between Ugboko and Ugo communities (Orhionmwon LGA, Edo). The perpetrators demanded a ransom for his release.

On 6 July 2021, about 270 suspected members of a militia attacked the village of Tsauwa, Batsari LGA (Katsina) [coded Batsari]. Between 19 and 21 residents were killed and many houses were set on fire.
On 6 July 2021, ISWAP members attacked a hospital in an IDP camp in Damboa LGA (Borno) [coded Damboa]. Six civilians were injured.

On 7 July 2021, members of the Yansakai group killed two members of a militia along the Mafara-Faru road, coded to known village in the Faru Magami ward, Magami Diddi (Maradun LGA, Zamfara) [coded to Faru Magami].
On 7 July 2021, an armed group opened fire against community members in Lalate (Ibarapa East LGA, Oyo). The group abducted a Fulani leader. No injuries or fatalities reported.

On 7 July 2021, gunmen shot and killed the Director of the Sciences Equipment Development Institute and his police escort near the entrance of the Centenary Estate, Uwani (Enugu South LGA, Enugu). The group also abducted the victim's daughter.
On 7 July 2021, members of a militia kidnapped between 9 to 15 individuals of the Ungwan Gimbiya community in Sabon Tasha (Chikun LGA, Kaduna). The group demanded ransom for their release.

On 7 July 2021, two unidentified cult militias clashed and shot a rival group member dead while celebrating the 7/7 Confraternity Day in Ugbokpo (Apa, Benue). The clash escalated and caused mayhem in the community.
On 7 July 2021, local militia attacked Kurawa, (Sabon Birni LGA, Sokoto state). Three people were killed in the attack.

On 7 July 2021, a clash between Eiye and Aye cult militias led to the killing of a militia member along Ibasa road, Ojo (Ojo, Lagos). The victim was a member of a rival cult group. On 7 July 2021, a former Special Assistant to a Governor was abducted by gunmen at the CBN roundabout, Bauchi (Bauchi LGA, Bauchi).

Around 7 July 2021 (between 7 - 8 July), members of a militia clashed with immigration officers and members of the military at the immigration checkpoint, near Kadobe village, Jibia LGA (Katsina) [coded Jibia]. On 8 July 2021, members of a militia killed a civilian during an attack in Kakkau, Chikun LGA [coded Kujama].

Around 8 July 2021 (between 8 - 9 July), around 34 members of a militia attacked the village of Makura (Mariga LGA, Niger), and four other communities in the region. No reports on injuries or fatalities.

Around 1 September 2021 (as reported), a female student was shot and killed by unidentified armed men in Bori (Khana, Rivers). The reason for the attack is unknown.

Around 27 October 2021 (as reported), armed men loyal to a leader of the APC attacked supporters of another APC leader in Idah (Idah, Kogi), one of the victims is in a critical condition.
On 27 October 2021, a farmer was killed by an unidentified armed group on his farm in Dobi (Gwagwalada, FCT).

Around 27 October 2021 (as reported), an unidentified armed group attacked a young man on Okwele Road, coded to Okwele (Isiala Mbano, Imo). He was killed in the attack. The reason for the attack is not known.

On 27 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted two men along Akwakuma road (Owerri North, Imo), coded as Orji. The victims were freed after their abductors fled following a chase by the police [no clash reported].
On 28 October 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked and killed four persons in Gurbin Baure (Zurmi, Zamfara). An unspecified number of persons were injured and several animals were rustled.
On 28 October 2021, unidentified armed men attempted to abduct two teachers in Osi (Ekiti, Kwara). One of the victims was wounded, the abduction attempt was unsuccessful.
On 28 October 2021, a Katsina militia attacked and killed five residents in Dangeza (Batsari, Katsina), coded to Batsari. Scores of individuals were wounded.

On 28 October 2021, suspected ISWAP militants clashed with military forces in Damboa (Damboa, Borno). Four persons including three policemen were killed, other sources report a dozen civilians and two policemen killed while the police office and three operational vehicles were set ablaze.
Around 28 October 2021 (as reported), ISWAP militants clashed with Nigerian soldiers in Kwada (Chibok, Borno), civilians were also attacked by the militants. Casualties unknown.
On 28 October 2021, soldiers repelled an attack on the convoy of the Borno state governor by suspected ISWAP militants around Malam Fatori (Abadan, Borno). Casualties unknown.

On 28 October 2021, presumed Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants clashed with military forces of Nigeria at Rann (Kala Balge, Borno). 4 militants were killed, 2 soldiers were wounded, weapons and ammunitions were recovered.

On 28 October 2021, Nigeria military forces clashed with Biafran National Guard militants in Amaekpu (Ohafia, Abia), coded as Ohafia. One BNG assailant was killed, weapons were recovered by the troops while the rest of the assailants fled and were intercepted at Ohaozara, Ebonyi.
On 28 October 2021, suspected IPOB militants killed three truck drivers and set their bodies ablaze in Orsu, coded as Afozuru (Imo).

On 28 October 2021, five people were killed in a clash between Owahwa and Okwagbe militias in one of the two areas (Ughelli South, Delta), coded as Okwagbe. Sources claim the clash is as a result of boundary dispute between the both communities.

On 29 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the chief imam of Yangoji central mosque, together with two of his sons, in Yangoji (Kwali, FCT). The abductors have demanded a ransom of 10 million naira.
On 29 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked Igbomoturu (Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa), coded as Ezeotu. One person was killed, three others were injured and two went missing.

On 29 October 2021, Nigerian soldiers raided ESN (IPOB) camps and clashed with the militants in Ochokwu (Ikwo, Ebonyi). Some militants were killed, weapons and ammunition were recovered by the soldiers. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 29 October 2021, Nigerian soldiers clashed with IPOB militants and killed four of them at Nnobi (Idemili South, Anambra). The militants were fleeing a clash with security agents at Ekwulobia.
On 29 October 2021, an Ijaw pastor from Ogbe-Ijoh was attacked by an Aladja militia in Aladja (Warri South, Delta). The victim died a few days later from injuries he sustained in the attack.
On 29 October 2021, a member of the Agbarho communal militia shot and killed a football player in Agbarho (Ughelli North, Delta). He was shot for trespassing into the palace of the Agbarho monarch.

Around 29 October 2021, ISWAP militants flogged 76 farmers abucted from an IDP camp in Ngala (Ngala, Borno) on 29 October. They were accused of collaborating with Nigerian soldiers. They were released on 31 October.
On 29 October 2021, a Kaduna militia abducted 9 people in Danglimi (Kachia, Kaduna), coded as Kachia.
On 29 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked Igbomoturu (Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa). One person was killed, three others were injured and two were missing.
On 29 October 2021, a Zamfara militia clashed with security agents in Shinkafi (Shinkafi, Zamfara). At least 20 were killed, around 19 police and 1 civilian.

On 29 October 2021, unidentified armed men ambushed a convoy with DSS operatives in Ekwulobia (Aguata, Anambra). Two DSS operatives and 1 civilian were killed, other sources report several persons also wounded.
On 29 October 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed a man on his way from the airport in Owerri (Owerri Municipal, Imo). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 30 October 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with security personnel at a construction site along Igbeddi/Amasomma road (Sagbama, Bayelsa), coded as Sagbama. One of the assailants was killed and an expatriate engineer was abducted.

On 30 October 2021, navy operatives engaged an unidentified armed group in an armed clash along the Ogonibiri waterways (Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa), coded as Olugbobiri. An expatriate that was abducted on the same day (coded separately) was rescued, and the abductors escaped with varying degrees of injuries.
On 30 October 2021, suspected Fulani militia abducted an unspecified number of travelers along the Sapele-Warri road (Sapele, Delta), coded as Sapele.

On 30 October 2021, a Katsina militia attacked and killed an unidentified number of civilians in Ungwan Dudu (Faskari, Katsina), coded as Faskari. The group looted shops during the attack and wounded an unspecified number of individuals. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 30 October 2021, Nigerian forces fired artillery against ISWAP/Boko Haram positions about six kilometers South West of Bama (Borno), coded as Bama. The gun trucks of the militants were neutralized. Casualties unknown.

On 30 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked the home of the leader of the Ilana Omo Oodua group in Ado-Ekiti (Ado Ekiti, Ekiti). The assailants fired gunshots into the air. There were no casualties from the attack.
On 31 October 2021, a man was killed by a Kaduna militia in Barebari (Igabi, Kaduna), coded as Bina.

Around 31 October 2021 (as reported), Dogo Gide, the leader of a Zamfara militia was killed in his hideout by some members of his group and a Dansadau militia. He was being treated for gunshot injuries sustained in a battle in Kwiambana Forest Reserve (Maru, Zamfara); other sources have refuted claims of his death.

On 31 October 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked worshippers at a Baptist church in Kakkau Daji (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Kakau. One worshipper was killed, other sources reported two; one was wounded, and 66 persons were abducted. The abductors have demanded food stuff to feed the abducted victims and a ransom of 99 million naira, two victims were killed and three others were injured by their captors on 6 November (coded separately). The victims were released around 4 December after an undisclosed amount was paid as ransom, the remaining 15 victims were released around 15 December, there are no details on ransom payment.
On 31 October 2021, soldiers foiled the attempted abduction of a catholic bishop by an unidentified armed group in Orlu (Orlu, Imo).
On 31 October 2021, a Kaduna militia killed two men in Sauran Giwa (Igabi, Kaduna). The victims were returning from a religious function when they were attacked.

Around 31 October 2021 (as reported), military forces of Nigeria foiled an attack by a Zamfara militia in Pan Dongari (Rafi, Niger). The troops received reinforcement from local militias of Kagara and Birinin Gwari villages. Causalities unknown.
On 31 October 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked and killed one local in the Kangon Kadi general area (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Chikun.

On 1 November 2021, Maza-Kuka armed members attacked a Fulani settlement and killed at least nine persons in Mashegu LGA (Niger) [coded as Mashegu]. The attack is said to be a reprisal for the attack on worshippers that happened around 25 October. The assailants stole cattle and other valuables.

Around 1 November 2021 (as reported), the head of the electrical engineering unit of the Federal Airport Authority of Nigeria was attacked and killed by an unidentified armed group and his body was found in a canal at Ifako-Ijaiye (Ifako, Lagos), coded as Ifako. The victim was last seen alive on 31 October when he left for his farm in Ogun state.

On 1 November 2021, soldiers invaded Mgbowo (Agwu, Enugu), killed an unspecified number of youths, burnt down the house of an IPOB leader, whom they were searching, as well as other houses. The soldiers shot sporadically to the air during the invasion. The army denied claims of indiscriminate shooting and confirmed the arrest of two IPOB leaders. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 1 November 2021, custom officials attacked Fagbohun (Egbado South, Ogun) and burnt down houses as a reprisal for the killing of two custom operatives by smugglers in the area. Residents claim some locals were arrested by the officials, and many have fled.
On 1 November 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack with automatic weapons on Nigerian army barracks in Bocobs, near Bama (Bama, Borno). A number of soldiers were wounded.

On 1 November 2021, a Katsina militia killed the chief imam of a mosque and an unspecified number of residents in Sabon Gari Bilbis (Faskari, Katsina), coded as Sabon Layi, for resisting the militia's abduction attempt. An unspecified number of women were also abducted while working at the victim's farm. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 1 November 2021, an attack was reported on NCoS officials by a group attempting to forcefully release an inmate in the court premises in Lagos (Lagos Island, Lagos). NCoS officials repelled the attack, shooting and injuring one assailant. Other sources claim three inmates that attempted to escape were killed.
On 2 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and killed seven people in Negga village of Bolki ward (Numan, Adamawa). Seven other people were wounded.
On 2 November 2021, suspected Fulani militia killed no fewer than seven civilians and wounded many others in Donadda (Lau, Taraba).

On 2 November 2021, an unidentified cult militia mounted on 3 motorcycles attacked and killed a commercial motorcyclist at Kuta market, coded to Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun). The victim was killed with machetes after he was shot at by the assailants.

On 2 November 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed two policemen at a checkpoint during a stop and search on Okija street, Diobu (Port Harcourt, Rivers). The assailants stole the rifles belonging to the policemen.

Around 2 November 2021 (as reported), a vigilante member who was abducted by armed individuals (coded separately) along the Abaji-Toto (Toto, Nassarawa), coded as Toto, was killed. A ransom of 2 million was paid for his release, reports suggest his abductors discovered he belonged to a vigilante group and decided to kill him.

On 2 November 2021, ISWAP claimed the abduction of one police officer and two traffic police oficers from a checkpoint set up by the militants along the Damaturu-Maiduguri road (Maiduguri Metro, Borno), coded as Maiduguri.

On 2 November 2021, Nigerian troops clashed with ISWAP [Lake Chad faction] militants who disguised as soldiers, set up a checkpoint, abducted travelers around Tasmukawu (Kaga, Borno). An unspecified number of passengers in three vehicles were initially abducted, all of whom, except five persons were later released.

On 2 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a professor, two of his children and other staff of the University of Abuja from the staff quarters at Giri (Gwagwalada, FCT), coded as Gwagwalada. The police report claims 6 people were abducted, the victims were rescued on 3 October by security agents.

On 2 November 2021, an unidentified cult group killed two people in Kuto and the Elite Road, Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun) in separate attacks (coded separately). One of the victims who was a commercial motorcycle operator was chased and hacked to death in broad day light, while the second victim was shot in a different location.

On 2 November 2021, a local militia from the Nahaci community ambushed and clashed with Zamfara militia members in the Kaura Namoda area (Kaura Namoda, Zamfara) while the group was moving after perpetrating an attack and rustling cattle in the nearby community of Magami Tandu in Kaura Namoda LGA. 7 Zamfara militia members were killed, including a ranking member of the group, and several others were injured.
On 2 November 2021, ASPAC members killed three persons who attacked a witch doctor in Edeoha (Ahoada, Rivers). The witch doctor prepares charms for the group.

On 2 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted two school children from the company of others along the Igarra-Auchi road (Akoko Edo, Edo), coded as Igarra. The abductors have demanded 100 million naira as ransom, the victims were released on 5 November after 6 million naira was paid as ransom.
On 3 November 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed a couple in Ekuma-Abavo (Ika South, Delta). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 3 November 2021, security forces and university security agents chased and clashed with armed men in Kwali area (Kwali, FCT). The armed men had abducted University of Abuja staff on the previous day (coded separately). The assailants fled the scene and abandoned the victims. There were no casualties.
On 3 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a retired general manager of Nigerian Ports Authority from his farm in Sitti (Sumaila, Kano). There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 3 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the vice principal of a junior secondary school in Yebu (Kwali, Kwali), coded as Kwali. The victim was released around 15 November, after a ransom of 2 million naira was paid.

On 3 November 2021, two girls were raped after they were abducted by unidentified armed men in Nuku (Kai Ama, Kwara), coded as Kaiama. The victims' family members were wounded in the attack. The victims were released after they were raped.

On 3 November 2021, suspected ISWAP militants [Lake Chad faction] clashed with soldiers when they attacked Magumeri (Magumeri, Borno). The militants burnt down a telecommunications mast during the attack, stole a refrigerator and bedsheets from the general hospital, other sources report that two policemen and one civilian were abducted. There were no casualties.

On 3 November 2021, suspected ISWAP militants clashed with Nigerian security forces on clearance patrol in Malam Fatori (Abadan, Borno). One soldier and two policemen were killed. ISWAP claimed the attack and the seizure of a wireless communication device from the soldiers.

On 3 November 2021, presumed Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants attacked a vigilante post in the vicinity of Pulka (Gwoza, Borno). The militants engaged in a clash with the militia until the militants retreated. Casualties unknown.
On 3 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked a university of Abuja lecturer on campus in Gwagwalada (Gwagwalada, FCT). There were casualties from the attack.

On 3 November 2021, Nigerian military forces carried out airstrikes supported with offensives by ground troops on Kaduna militias in Gaude and Kauwuri villages (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Chikun. Dozens of militiamen were killed, fatalities coded as 12.
On 4 November 2021, a security agent was killed by suspected cattle rustlers at the Iware international cattle market (Ardo Kola, Taraba). The agent was killed while trying to arrest some suspects.

On 4 November 2021, at least four policemen were killed in a clash between the policemen and an unidentified armed group at a checkpoint in Orifite (Ekwusigwo, Anambra); the reason for the attack is unknown. The assailants stole the rifles belonging to the killed policemen.

On 4 November 2021, security forces composed by the military, police forces and a local Fulani militia called Yan Banga, clashed with an unidentified armed group during an ambush in a forest in Eruku (Ekiti, Kwara) where the kidnappers were collecting ransom. One member of the armed group was killed.

On 4 November 2021, a tricycle driver was killed by a policeman over his refusal to pay a bribe in Ipaja (Alimosho, Lagos). Some sources claim the victim was shot by the policeman while others claim he was stabbed.

On 4 November 2021, unidentified armed men killed two persons while attempting to abduct an Akwa Ibom state house of assembly member in Uquo (Eket, Akwa Ibom), coded to Eket. The group was unsuccessful in the abduction.

On 4 November 2021, suspected members of a Zamfara militia abducted a businessman from his farm along the Gusau-Dansadau road (Gusau, Zamfara), coded as Gusau. The victim was abducted along with six people last year and escaped, there are no reports about ransom demands.
On 4 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked an unarmed Fulani pastoralist in Oro Ago (Ifelodun, Kwara). The victim was left unconscious, 15 cattle were rustled by the assailants.
On 4 November 2021, military forces repelled an attack by presumed Boko Haram/ISWAP militants around Gajigana (Nganzai, Borno), coded as Gajiram. Casualties unknown.

On 4 November 2021, Nigerian army and NAF carried out joint operations in the vicinity of Mandaragirau and Sabon Gari (Biu, Borno), coded as Sabon Gari, against presumed Boko Haram/ISWAP militants. Casualties unknown.

On 4 November 2021, gunmen, presumed to be a Niger militia, abducted four women from Agwan Gwari Kwamba in Suleja (Suleja, Niger). Other sources reports three women and one man abducted, there are no reports about demands for ransom.
On 5 November 2021, suspected Fulani militias attacked Abuyab village (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Abobo. Ten people were killed by the attackers and houses were burnt down.
On 5 November 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked and killed no fewer than ten people in Yagbal and Ungwan Ruhugo (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Zangon Katab. The assailants burnt houses in the attack.

On 5 November 2021, the aide-de-camp of the Gombe state governor, together with other armed individuals, attacked the convoy of senator Danjuma Goje in Gombe (Gombe, Gombe). The governor denied links with the attack and accused the senator of arming his supporters; one person was killed and vehicles were vandalized.
On 5 November 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed three men who were passers-by at Umulogho (Obowo, Imo). The reason for the attack is unknown.
On 5 November 2021, a sharia court judge and his sister in-law were abducted by a Katsina militia on the way to Funtua (Funtua, Katsina). The abductors demanded for a ransom of 15 million naira.

On 5 November 2021, no fewer than 17 persons from the Amuda group were killed during an attack by an Ezza militia in Effium (Ohaukwu, Ebonyi). An unspecified number of persons were wounded and hospitalized due to the attack.

On 6 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants attacked four journalists and three domestic election observers in Orkija (Ihiala, Anambra). The victims were beaten, robbed and their vehicle was burnt. There were no fatalities.

On 6 November 2021, two abducted Baptist church worshipers were killed and three other were seriously injured by a Kaduna militia in or around Kakkau Daji (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Kakau. A group of 66 worshipers were kidnapped by the group on 31 October (coded separately).

On 6 November 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with policemen at the Obada-Oko area of Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun). The armed group abducted three persons and wounded one other person who escaped. An initial ransom of 10 million, later reduced to 1.2 million and hard drugs were demanded.

On 6 November 2021, IPOB claimed that its security outfit ESN repelled an attack by armed Fulani pastoralists in some undisclosed Biafra communities in Enugu state [coded to Enungu, Enugu North LGA]. Casualties unknown.

On 6 November 2021, ISWAP militants abducted three men who are brothers of the emir of Askira while they were travelling to Maiduguri from Askira (Askira Uba, Borno). The abductees were released around 31 March 2022, there are no reports about ransom payments.

On 6 November 2021, unidentified armed individuals attacked and killed a journalist in Calabar (Calabar Municipal, Cross River). The police claim the assailants could be militia members pursuing robbers or the robbers themselves.

On 6 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked a polling unit in Ekwulobia (Aguata, Anambra). The attackers stole ballot boxes and other electoral materials during the gubernatorial elections. Party agents and INEC officials were also attacked which brought elections to a halt. Casualties unknown.

On 6 November 2021, unidentified armed men shooting indiscriminately invaded two polling units in Fegge (Onisha South, Anambra) and stole ballot boxes during the gubernatorial election, scaring away voters, INEC officers and security operatives. There were no injures.
On 7 November 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked and killed six persons in Rijiya (Gusau, Zamfara). Several others were abducted by the assailants.

On 8 November 2021, suspected Fulani militia members attacked civilians in Kibori (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna). About 5 persons were killed and several others were wounded, houses and foodstuff were destroyed.
On 8 November 2021, suspected Fulani militia members attacked civilians in Atagjeh (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Zangon Katab. 3 persons were killed and 3 others were wounded.

On 8 November 2021, at least 60 armed men, assumed to be land grabbers, clashed with policemen when they invaded Idiagbon community (Ado-Odo, Ogun), coded as Ado Odo. Two of the assailants were later arrested by the police. Casualties unknown.

On 8 November 2021, a Kaduna militia abducted about 20 travelers, mostly women, along the Zaria-Giwa highway (Zaria, Kaduna), coded as Zaria. 13 of the abductees were staff of Zaria LGA; the abductors have contacted the victims' families and requested various amount as ransom. 10 victims were released on 27 November, no reports about whether ransom was paid.

On 8 November 2021, Nigerian soldiers clashed with ISWAP militants in Tamsukawu, seven kilometers from Ngamdu (Kaga, Borno). The militants set up a checkpoint in the area along the highway and stopped vehicles before air and ground troops engaged them. Casualties unknown.
On 8 November 2021, an Evangelical pastor was kidnapped by members of a Kaduna militia at Nariya (Igabi, Kaduna), coded to Igabi. The abductors demanded a ransom of 5 million naira.

Around 8 November 2021 (as reported), Kaduna militiamen abducted a woman married to an Evangelical pastor that went to deliver ransom for the release of her husband in Igabi LGA (Kaduna). Her husband was abducted on 8 November [coded separately], the woman was released on 6 December.

On 8 November 2021, members of a Zamfara militia ambushed a team of mobile policemen patrolling the Magami-Gusau highway (Gusau, Zamfara), coded to Magami. At least 7 policemen were killed, their operational vehicle was set ablaze, an unspecified number escaped and are yet to be found.

Around 9 November 2021 (as reported), a Niger militia abducted two family members of victims abducted from Maza-Kuka who went to deliver the ransom requested by the militia. Location coded as Mashegu (Mashegu, Niger).

On 9 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and shot at traders in Anara market (Isiala Mbano, Imo), coded as Amaraka. At least 4 persons were killed in the attack. The motive of the attack is unknown.

On 9 November 2021, two unidentified communal militias clashed in Nkalagu (Ishielu, Ebonyi). An unspecified number of persons were killed, security operatives were deployed to the area. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 9 November 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked a residence in Abusoro community (Akure North, Ondo), coded as Iju, and killed one person. The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 9 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants and Nigerian military, police and civil defense forces engaged in a clash for three hours at Osumoghu junction in Ihiala LGA (Anambra), coded as Ihiala. The militants fled following the gunfire exchange, and were suspected to be going to the collation center of the supplementary election before the clash. Casualties unknown.
On 9 November 2021, soldiers shot and killed a man while they were patrolling in Ihiala (Ihiala, Anambra). The victim's body was picked up by the soldiers.

Around 9 November 2021 (as reported), three Eiye militiamen gang-raped a girl in the Kajola area of Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun) and dispossessed her of her properties. The police later arrested the militiamen and paraded them in public.
On 9 November 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted two persons along the Ayetoro road in Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun). The victims were rescued by security forces around 11 October.

On 9 November 2021, suspected Kaduna militiamen attacked and killed a retired NAF officer and his wife at his residence in Rigasa (Igabi, Kaduna). Other reports indicate that the attack was perpetrated by 'suspected assassins.'

On 9 November 2021, members of a Katsina militia attacked no less than five communities in Batsari (Batsari, Katsina), coded as Batsari. 11 people were killed and 13 others were wounded; houses were burnt.
On 9 November 2021, a group claimed suspected armed Fulani pastoralists attacked and killed their kinsman on his farm in Amogwugwu, Enungu state. Location coded to Enugu (Enugu North, Enugu).

On 9 November 2021, ISWAP claimed an ambush on a convoy on Nigerian army vehicles along the Ngamdu-Tasmakawa road (Kaga, Borno), coded as Ngamdu. Three soldiers were killed, an unspecified number were wounded and the rest fled.

On 9 November 2021, military forces repelled an attempted attack by ISWAP [Lake Chad Faction] militants on six 'technical' in Ngwom (Mafa, Borno). At least four militants were killed. ISWAP claimed the attack was on military barracks.
On 10 November 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked Shiliam village, in the Atyap Chiefdom (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Zangon Katab. Three women were killed by the assailants.

On 10 November 2021, members of a Sokoto militia abducted the wife of a pastor traveling to Sokoto from Tsafe. A ransom of 30 million was demanded but was negotiated to 2.5 million. Location coded as Tureta (Tureta, Sokoto); the victim was released around 12 November, the ransom of 2.5 million was paid.

On 10 November 2021, armed individuals attacked the Binnari and Jab Jab villages (Karim Lamidu, Taraba), coded as Jen, in retaliation of the killing of its gang members by a local militia in the area a few weeks ago (coded separately). At least 15 persons, including 3 women, were killed and houses set ablaze.
On 10 November 2021, a Sokoto militia abducted 5 persons in Gatawa (Sabon Birni, Sokoto). The abductors have demanded for a ransom of five hundred thousand naira.
On 10 November 2021, members of a Niger militia killed a person and abducted two children of a shop owner at Gidan Kwanu, Minna (Niger). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.
On 10 November 2021, a woman was abducted by unidentified armed men in the NTA area of Port Harcourt (Port Harcourt, Rivers). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

On 10 November 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked Tungar Ruwa (Anka, Zamfara), coded as Anka, and killed nine people, including the village head. Other sources claim scores of residents were killed, the assailants looted foodstuff and domestic animals.

On 10 November 2021, suspected ISWAP militants invaded Krangla, eight kilometers from Askira town (Askira Uba, Borno) and shot sporadically into the air, burning several houses. Casualties are unknown.

On 10 November 2021, Nigerian forces clashed with ISWAP militants who attacked a military formation with a dozen gun trucks in Kukawa LGA (Borno), coded Duguri. The troops were supported with airstrikes by NAF and scores of militants were killed. Fatalities coded as 20.

On 10 November 2021, the Nigerian army claimed an ambush against Boko Haram/ISWAP militants in Pulka (Gwoza, Borno). The soldiers collaborated with the CJTF and local militia members. Four militants were killed, weapons were recovered and several others fled with gunshot wounds.

On 10 November 2021, a NSCDC officer shot and wounded a man for urinating within the corps' premises in Calabar (Calabar Municipal, Cross River). The victim was taken to the hospital and is in critical condition.
On 10 November 2021, unidentified armed men killed the president of the Ogidi youth and three others in the Anambra state. Location coded as Ogidi (Idemili North, Anambra).
On 10 November 2021, the Nigerian army killed three members of a Benue militia during a military operation in the militia's camp north of Katsina-Ala (Katsina Ala, Benue).

On 11 November 2021, a commercial motorcycle driver was killed by unidentified armed men along the Koko Campus Iree (Ifelodun, Osun), coded as Ikirun. The victim's motorcycle was taken away by the assailants
Around 11 November 2021 (as reported), police forces clashed with a Kaduna militia along the Kaduna-Abuja highway (Kachia, Kaduna), coded as Katari. The militia members fled with gunshot wounds.

Around 11 November 2021 (as reported), police forces joined by soldiers and members of So Safe Corps ambushed and clashed with unknown gunmen around Abule Oba Alamala (Abeokuta South, Ogun), coded to Abeokuta, as the group was trying to receive ransom payment for abducted victims (coded separately). The suspects fled; some with gunshot wounds and 3 were arrested by the police, the victims were rescued.

On 11 November 2021, ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants abmushed military forces along the Monguno-Maiduguri road, coded to Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno). The soldiers' vehicles transporting fighting equipment struck IEDs planted by the militants. The militants sized the equipment as well as some cash. 12 soldiers were killed.
On 12 November 2021, a Katsina militia abducted eleven persons from Sabon Gari (Safana, Katsina). The victims were rescued by the police around 14 November.

On 12 November 2021, about 300 unidentified armed men attacked the Agbaakin community, close to Mowe (Obafemi, Ogun), raped women and abducted two residents. The assailants looted and destroyed houses and shops. Casualties unknown.
On 12 November 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on a patrol of the Nigerian army, which resulted in a clash, near Baga (Kukawa, Borno). The army fled. There were no casualties.
On 12 November 2021, a presumed Katsina militia attacked and killed six persons in the Gwarjo area (Matazu, Katsina). Nine other persons were wounded by the assailants.

On 13 November 2021, armed men attacked Mbayatyo in Mbater council (Logo, Benue), coded as Ugba. 4 persons, including the head of the community guards, who were attending a wake, were killed, scores were injured. The local council chairman claimed the assailants were Fulani pastoralists, while the police claimed they are members of a militia.

On 13 November 2021, Nigerian troops, supported by NAF, clashed with ISWAP militants in Askira Uba LGA (Borno), coded as Askira. Over 50 militants, including top commanders, were killed. A general and three soldiers were killed in an ambush by the militants while providing reinforcement in the area; the troops destroyed 9 gun trucks belonging to the militants. ISWAP claimed the killing of 17 soldiers, capture of weapons, ammunition and a SUV and the burning of the Askira base.

On 13 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a protestant pastor and a teacher at Ikot Eno-obong, 8 miles from Calabar (Calabar Municipal, Cross River). The victims were released on 15 November after their abductors received a ransom of about 200,000 naira as against the initial demand of 7 million. The lower ransom was received by the abductors following speculations that security forces were closing in on them.
On 13 November 2021, unknown gunmen killed a couple in Kebberi village (Malam Madori, Jigawa), coded as Malummaduri.

On 14 November 2021, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists, dressed in military camouflage, abducted a pregnant woman and ten other travelers in Ole (Isoko South, Delta). The victims were rescued by the police in collaboration with a vigilante group and hunters.
On 14 November 2021, a kaduna militia invaded a protestant church during service and abducted a pastor and other worshippers in Buda (Kajuru, Kaduna). There are no reports about demands for ransom.

Around 14 November 2021 (as reported), a man was abducted by unidentified armed men in Chiromawa (Garun Mallam, Kano). The victim was released on the same day after the police and local vigilante launched a rescue mission that put pressure on the abductors.

Around 14 November 2021 (between 14 - 15 November), a Sokoto militia attacked five communities in Illela LGA (Sokoto), coded to Illela, and killed 43 persons. The communities were Munwadata, Kalmalo, Sarma, Runji Tunbulunkun and Tafkin Taramniya. The reason for the attack is unknown.
On 14 November 2021, a Sokoto militia attacked Kojiyo (Goronyo, Sokoto), killed three persons and abducted three women. The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 14 November 2021, a Niger militia abducted no fewer than four persons, including the owner of a sachet water factory, in Tegina (Rafi, Niger). The police confirmed the incident and claimed one of the victims escaped, the abductors have demanded a ransom of 150 million naira. Two of the victims including the factory worker and an officer in charge of immunization in the area were killed in captivity later [coded separately]. The abductors demanded 20 million naira and a smartphone to release the corpses and the third victim alive.

On 14 November 2021, members of a Zamfara militia numbering up to a hundred attacked Kwarin Mai Saje (Tsafe, Gusau), coded as Tsafe, raped an unspecified number of women, abducted six persons and looted valuables. The attack was a punitive measure on the village over its failure to pay a levy imposed by the militia.

On 14 November 2021, a Katsina militia clashed with the police at Danmarabu village (Kankara, Katsina), coded as Kankara, as the group attacked Gidan Duka village and rustled unspecified number of cattle. The group fled, leaving all animals.
On 15 November 2021, a sokoto militia attacked, killed three persons, and abducted three others in Garin Zago village (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), coded as Gobir.

Around 15 November 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists killed three butchers at the Ajagbusi community (Akure North, Ondo), coded as Iju. Four butchers were abducted on 15 November, and the body of two of them were found on 16 November; the third body was not found and the fourth victim escaped with injuries.
On 15 November 2021, the Nigerian military repelled an attack by a militia in Zango Urban District (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Zangon Katab. There were no fatalities.

On 15 November 2021, a Niger militia attacked several communities in Muya LGA (Niger), coded as Sarkin Pawa, burning down three of them. Between 300 to 400 people were sacked from their homes in the attack which continued till the next day, a number of families have declared their relatives missing. Unknown fatalities.

On 15 November 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted the traditional ruler of Oguaniocha from his palace in Oguaniocho (Ogbaru, Anambra). The palace and four of the victim's cars were burnt by the abductors.

On 15 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked the palace of the clan head of Ikpomolokpo in Gege ward (Ado, Benue), coded as Agila. The son of the traditional leader was killed and his daughter was abducted. The status of the man and his wife are unconfirmed.

On 15 November 2021, intra-communal clashes broke out due to leadership tussle in Uhkirhi (Ikpoba Okha, Edo), which led to the killing of five persons, four of whom are from the same family. Five houses and cars belonging to locals were set ablaze.
On 15 November 2021, Nigerian soldiers repelled an attack from ISWAP in Dille (Askira Uba, Borno). ISWAP claimed the attack, saying the Nigerian soldiers fled. There were no fatalities.

Around 15 November 2021, Boko Haram militants have took Hanawanka and Madaka communities in Rafi LGA (Niger), coded as Kagara, according to the secretary to the Niger state government. He claimed the takeover has prompted locals to seek refuge in other areas. No clashes were reported.

Around 15 November 2021, Boko Haram militants took over Kurebe, Gussau and Farin Kuka communities in Shiroro LGA (Niger), according to the secretary to the Niger state government. He claimed the takeover has prompted locals to seek refuge in other areas. No clashes were reported.

On 15 November 2021, NSCDC officers clashed with a large number of members of a sokoto militia that attacked Sokoto metropolis (Sokoto North, Sokoto). One officer was killed and their operational vehicle was vandalized by the assailants.
On 16 November 2021, a sokoto militia attacked and killed one person in Unguwar Lalle town (Sabon Birni, Sokoto).
On 16 November 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked and killed three persons in Unguwar Shukau (Ikara, Kaduna), coded as Ikara.
On 16 November 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked civilians and killed two persons at Rafin Kada (Wukari, Taraba). An unspecified number of persons were wounded.

On 16 November 2021, a Niger militia continued the attack against several communities in Muya LGA (Niger), coded as Sarkin Pawa, for the second day, burning down three of them. Between 300 to 400 people were sacked from their homes in the attack which lasted two days, a number of families have declared their relatives missing. Unknown fatalities.

On 16 November 2021, a Sokoto militia shot at a commercial vehicle in Gadji village (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), coded as Gatawa. Three persons, including the driver, were killed; five others were wounded and three other persons were abducted from the village and later released after the locals agreed that a ransom of 2 million naira would be paid in a few days, other sources claim there were no casualties in the attack.
On 16 November 2021, presumed Boko Haram/ISWAP militants clashed with hunters in the vicinity of Hashime (Mafa, Borno). There are no further details. Casualties unknown.
On 16 November 2021, a sokoto militia attacked and killed nine persons in Tsangerawa village (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), coded as Sabon Birni.
On 16 November 2021, a sokoto militia attacked and killed four persons in Tamindawa village (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), coded as Tara.
On 17 November 2021, a student of Michael Otedola college of primary health education was killed by unidentified armed men on campus in Epe (Epe, Lagos). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 17 November 2021, a Niger militia attacked and killed two persons, including a hunter, in Zagaga community in Muya LAG (Niger), coded as Sarkin Pawa; other sources report one fatality. 70 persons were abducted, including women and children, three others sustained gunshot injuries. The attacks across communities in Muya lasted three days, the abductors have demanded for a ransom of 150 million naira.

On 17 November 2021, a Katsina militia ambushed security forces at Kandawa (Batsari, Katsina), an unspecified number of operatives were killed and an unspecified number of persons were wounded. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 17 November 2021, security forces dispersed suspected IPOB militants who hoisted a Biafran flag at the entry route to Bakassi LGA. The militants had attacked and chased away the security men at the entry point and harassed residents, the forces removed the flag, restored order and imposed a temporary curfew. Location coded to Bakassi (Biase, Cross River).

On 17 November 2021, a Niger communal militia abducted two shop owners, one male and one female, in Minna (Minna, Niger). The militia had threatened to abduct the businessman two months prior, if certain conditions were not met. There are not reports about demands for ransom.
