On 17 November 2021, a sokoto militia attacked, killed six persons, and injured many others in Sangirawa (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), coded as Sabon Birni

On 17 November 2021, suspected Ambazonian separatist soldiers from Cameroon attacked Manga community in Takum (Takum, Taraba) and killed no fewer than eleven persons, including a traditional ruler. Residents claim that as of 22 November, over 20 persons and two children are still missing.
On 17 November 2021, a Zamfara militia fired at civilians and abducted 13 from Yandoto (Tsafe, Zamfara), coded as Tsafe. Casualties unknown.

Around 18 November 2021 (as reported), two different groups of katsina militias clashed in the Sabon Birni forest (Igabi, Kaduna). 10 militiamen, including the leader of one of the groups, were killed; the cattle belonging to the group were taken back to Katsina by militia members who survived the clash.

On 18 November 2021, members of TOP faction of the APC were attacked by suspected members of the Ileri Oluwa faction of the party during a meeting in Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun). An unspecified number of persons were wounded.

On 18 November 2021, police officers and members of a vigilante group clashed with a Katsina militia in a hideout in Baure (Safana, Katsina). Two police officers and two militia members were killed; weapons and ammunition were recovered by the police.

On 18 November 2021, armed men shot sporadically and killed seven people in Tor Donga (Katsina Ala, Benue). Members of the community volunteer guards and a priest were among the people killed, five others were injured.

On 18 November 2021, suspected Boko haram militants abducted 22 girls between the ages of 14 to 17 in Kurebe (Rafi, Niger), coded as Kagara. Other sources reports that the abductors sent a letter to the community stating plans to marry the victims.
On 18 November 2021, presumed ISWAP/ Boko haram militants attacked civilians in Kafin Hausa village in Hyambula (Madagali, Adamawa). Casualties unknown.
On 19 November 2021, a lecturer of Michael Otedola college of primary health education was killed by unidentified armed men around Poka (Epe, Lagos). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 19 November 2021, two pastoralists were killed by unidentified armed men in Ashige (Lafia, Nassarawa). The victim's bodies were found with cuts on their faces, the reason for the attack is unknown.

On 19 November 2021, a man was shot and killed by a policeman over his refusal to pay a bribe in Jalingo (Jalingo, Taraba). The victim died in the hospital on 23 November, other sources report that the victim was shot following an altercation with the policeman.

On 19 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the father of a former deputy governor of Imo state in Iho (Ikeduru, Imo), the victim is also the traditional ruler of Ezi-Mbieri Autonomous community. The victim was released after six days, reports do not indicate whether or not ransom was paid.

On 19 November 2021, the Nigerian military claimed to have repelled an attempt by ISWAP militants to attack Damboa (Damboa, Borno). 11 ISWAP members were killed, six civilians were wounded. The militants tried to invaded the town in gun trucks.

Around 19 November 2021 (as reported), the Aye and Eiye cult militiamen clashed in Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun) and Itori, coded separately. Four militiamen were killed in the supremacy clash that erupted between the two groups. 4 fatalities shared between the two events. 2 fatalities were recorded.

Around 19 November 2021 (as reported), the Aye and Eiye cult militias clashed in Itori (Ewekoro, Ogun) and Abeokuta in a supremacy tussle, coded separately. Four militiamen were killed in the bloody clash. 4 fatalities shared between the two events. 2 fatalities were reported.

On 19 November 2021, Nigerian security forces in a joint operation comprising Nigerian Army, Air Force, Police, and DSS, carried out air raids and ground operations against militias in Sabon Birni (coded separately) and Isa (Sokoto). Several to hundreds of militiamen were reported killed including relatives and lieutenants of militia leaders, with several others wounded. Unknown fatalities coded as 10 and split across two events.

On 19 November 2021, Nigerian security forces in a joint operation comprising Nigerian Army, Air Force, Police, and DSS, carried out air raids and ground operations against militias in Isa (coded separately) and Sabon Birni (Sokoto). Several to hundreds of militiamen were reported killed including relatives and lieutenants of militia leaders, with several others wounded. Unknown fatalities coded as 10 and split across two events.

On 20 November 2021, a group of suspected saw millers attacked civilians in Egume (Dekina, Kogi), wounded dozens of people and destroyed properties. The assailants shot sporadically in the air during the attack.

On 20 November 2021, a Niger militia attacked Maikonkele (Bosso, Niger) and fired indiscriminately before abducting one person. The abductors had earlier written a letter to inform the victims of their attack. There are reports about ransom demands. There were no casualties.
On 20 November 2021, two unidentified cult militias clashed at Bonny (Bonny, Rivers). Casualties unknown.

On 20 November 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted 8 workers of a water factory including the owner in Sosoki in Alapa (Asa, Kwara). The police confirmed the release of 7 victims the following day during a rescue mission, the owner of the factory is yet be released.

On 20 November 2021, a Niger militia abducted 10 people from Zagazaga in Muya (Niger), coded as Sarkin Pawa. The militia had abducted 70 other people from the same community the same week, the abductors have demanded for 150 million naira as ransom for the release of all 80 victims, eight persons escaped two weeks after they were abducted. 5 million naira was paid as ransom, 19 victims escaped, the other 37 were released around 24 December.
On 20 November 2021, sea pirates attacked civilians, coded to Yenagoa (Yenagoa, Bayelsa). 4 people were killed including workers of NCDSC and three oil workers.

On 20 November 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack which resulted in clashes with Nigerian troops in Marte (Marte, Borno), persons linked to the state were abducted, the militants looted hospital supplies and burnt down a house occupied by members of the CJTF. They claimed four soldiers and two vigilantes were killed.

On 20 November 2021, an unidentified armed group attempted to abduct a PDP member from his residence in Bukwan Kato in Lafia (Lafia, Nassarawa). The abduction was foiled by the police and some civilians, the assailants shot and wounded one civilian before fleeing [no clash was reported with the police].

On 20 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a farmer while he was returning from his farm in Olla town (Osin, Kwara). Other sources report that the victim was wounded as a result of an attempt to resist his abductors, the victim's body was found around 25 November and the police claims he died as a result of the injuries he sustained while being abducted.
On 20 November 2021, an unidentified armed group injured a policeman and snatched his rifle in Izombe (Oguta, Imo). Another person was killed by the same group on a bush path in the area.

On 20 November 2021, police forces claimed the killing of a suspected IPOB militant during a clash along Owerri-Onitsha road (Owerri Municipal, Imo), location coded as Owerri. The clash ensued while police men were searching a bus in which the suspect was travelling.

On 21 November 2021, a woman who testified as a witness at the Lagos judicial panel for #EndSARS was attacked and wounded by unidentified armed men in Lekki (Ibeju-Lekki, Lagos) for testifying before the panel.

On 21 November 2021, a Katsina militia numbering over 100 attacked and killed four persons in Barawa (Batagarawa, Katsina). Several others were wounded and the assailants conducted a house to house search to loot.

On 21 November 2021, a militia from Ogbe-Ijoh attacked and clashed with Aladja communal militia in Aladja (Warri South, Delta) in reprisal of the killing of an Ogbe-Ijoh local by suspected Aladja militia members in October [coded separately]. One Aladja local was killed, members of the Ogbe-Ijoh militia sustained injuries, a house was also burnt.

On 21 November 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted a doctor around Esigi village near Bakassi (Biase, Cross River) and taken to a nearby forest by the abductors. The victim was rescued by the police after his abductors fled following a trail by the police.

On 21 November 2021, soldiers attacked and beat up the Galadima of Tunga Maje and his family members at his house in Tunga Maje (Gwagwalada, FCT). Eight persons were injured as a result, the reason for the attack is unknown.

Around 21 November 2021 (as reported), security forces ambushed and killed the leader of a Kaduna militia in Kaduna South (Kaduna South, Kaduna). The militia was responsible for the abduction of several travellers on 21 November, security forces seized a motorcycle and rifle belonging to the leader of the militia.

On 21 November 2021, the Zamfara state gubernatorial candidate of the APC was attacked and killed by a Kaduna militia around Rijana (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Chikun. The orderly of the victim was abducted by the assailants and 200 million naira was demanded for his release, other sources report other travellers were also killed.

On 21 November 2021, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists abducted the daughter of the chairman of Agu-Amede community neighbourhood watch corps from his residence. Location coded as Ikem (Isi Uzo, Enugu), the abductors took away valuables and have demanded a ransom of 15 million naira.

On 22 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted an Igbo ethnic chief in Ifon (Ose, Ondo). The abductors took an undisclosed amount of money from the victim's car, victim is also resident in the community where he was abducted. The abductors demanded for 100 million naira as ransom; the victim was released on 26 November after an undisclosed amount was paid.
On 22 November 2021, a teacher was shot and killed by unidentified armed men in Epe (Epe, Lagos), his colleagues claim he was shot by a student he flogged while the NUT refuted the claim.

On 22 November 2021, armed Fulani pastoralists ambushed an Ekiti militia team on patrol in the Oko-Obo-Ile axis (Ekiti, Kwara), coded as Eruku. One Ekiti militia member was wounded and one pastoralist was arrested.

Around 22 November 2021 (as reported), two members of the Eiye cult militia attacked a student of Olabisi Onabanjo University in Ijebu-Igbo (Ijebu North, Ogun) while trying to initiate him into their cult group forcefully. They lured the victim to the bush, where they blindfolded and beat him. The police later arrested the cultists.

On 22 November 2021, a Kaduna militia abducted an unspecified number of travellers along Kaduna-Abuja highway (Kachia, Kaduna), coded as Katari. The abduction was the second in a row; the first occurred the previous day, there are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 22 November 2021, a Zamfara militia abducted travellers along the Gusau-Tsafe-Funtua road. The victims were rescued by the police [no reports about a clash]. Location coded as Gusau (Gusau, Zamfara).

On 22 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants clashed with soldiers while trying to enforce a sit in order in Awo-Omamma (Oru East, Imo). One soldier and one militant were killed, the militants were successfully dispersed.

On 23 November 2021, armed pastoralists (presumably Fulani militia) attacked Bularafa village (Gulami, Yobe) and were repelled by security forces. Five persons were wounded and five pastoralists were arrested.

On 23 November 2021, military forces clashed with a Sokoto militia at Kuzari village in Kurawa (Sabon Birni, Sokoto). Several militiamen were killed, motorcycles and weapons were recovered by the troops and one soldier was wounded. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 23 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants attacked and razed down a police station in Ndizuogu (Ideato North, Imo). One policeman was killed in the attack, machete cuts were inflicted on the head of another officer, one police vehicle and the personal car of an officer were also burnt.
On 23 November 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked and killed two people on their farm in Ancha village, Miango (Bassa, Plateau).

On 24 November 2021, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists abducted over ten passengers and raped and killed a woman along Isuikwato-Uturu road (Isuikwuato, Abia), coded as Onuaku Uturu. The victims were mostly students and lecturers, there are no reports about demands for ransom.
On 24 November 2021, unidentified armed men invaded the residence of a businessman and killed him in Agbor (Ika South, Delta). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 24 November 2021, pastoralists (presumably Fulani) and farmers clashed at Zagari, Gubusun, and Likori communities in Kiri Kasamma (Kiri-Kasamma, Jigawa). At least one person was killed and an unspecified number of persons were wounded.
On 24 November 2021, unidentified armed men killed one person and abducted six others on a farm at Lagbeta community (Kogi, Kogi), coded to Koton-Karfe. There are no reports for ransom demands yet.
On 24 November 2021, Danish military forces clashed with pirates in Port Harcourt (Port Harcourt, Rivers). Four pirates were killed and one other was wounded.
On 24 November 2021, at least five farmers were killed by pastoralists ransacking farms around Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno).

On 24 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a timber contractor and five other persons in Achido Tsoho (Toto, Nassarawa), coded as Toto. The abductors have demanded for a ransom of 9 million naira.

On 24 November 2021, Nigerian soldiers clashed with Sokoto militiamen loyal to the Turji faction in Tsakai forest, coded to Sabon Birni (Sabon Birni, Sokoto). An unspecified number of militiamen were killed, coded as 3.
On 24 November 2021, a commercial driver was abducted by unidentified armed individuals around the Ugha community, along the Benin-Auchi road, coded to Benin City (Oredo, Edo).

On 24 November 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted a three year old girl from her parents' residence on Ondo road in Akure South LGA (Ondo), coded as Akure. The abductors have demanded for a ransom of 20 million naira.

On 25 November 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked Yanbuki (Zurmi, Zamfara) and killed seven persons. About 50 women and children were abducted, houses, shops and traditional silos were burnt by the assailants.

On 25 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked Orobomi community (Kogi, Kogi), coded as Koton-Karfe, and abducted no fewer than five persons, including one woman. There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

On 25 November 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted four person, including the principal and teachers from the same school, along Auga-Ise road (Akoko South West, Ondo), coded as Akunba. The abductors have demanded for a ransom of 35 million naira; the victims were released on 29 November, no reports about whether a ransom was paid.
On 25 November 2021, five traders were abducted by a Niger militia along Beji-Manta road (Shiroro, Niger), coded as Shiroro. There are no reports about demands of ransom yet.

On 26 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and killed at least 11 persons in Ta'agbe community (Bassa, Plateau), coded as Bassa. Thirty houses were also set ablaze by the assailants and about 700 persons were displaced.

On 26 November 2021, CJTF members clashed with remnants of Boko Haram Abubakar Shekau faction who attacked farmers and looted food along the Maiduguri-Damaturu highway, near or around Lambua (Kaga, Borno). Three militants were killed, one was arrested.

On 26 November 2021, an off-duty policeman driving in his private vehicle was abducted by unidentified armed men along the Auchi-Ekperi-Agenebode road (Etsako West, Edo). The abductors have demanded for a ransom of 50 million naira; around 3 December, the police announced that the victim had been rescued; no details on whether a ransom was paid.
On 26 November 2021, armed men killed two residents of Durbi (Jos East, Plateau) who were chasing them after the community was informed of their presence.

On 27 November 2021, members of a Niger militia invaded Chibani (Muya, Niger), coded as Sarkin Pawa, and abducted over 50 persons, 12 of whom are family members of the chairman of Shiroro local government; the abductors demanded for 130 million but later reduced to 60 million naira as ransom for the members of the chairman's family.

On 28 November 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked Askawa (Zurmi, Zamfara), coded as Zurmi, and abducted about 18 people, mostly women and children. A man and his wife were killed, and the abductors have demanded for a ransom of 5 million naira. One of the victims was released to convey the message.

On 28 November 2021, sea pirates attacked two staff Agip oil company and clashed with NSCDC officers who tried to repel the attack around Okoroma (Nembe, Bayelsa), coded as Nembe. One NSCDC official and two oil workers were killed, two other missing NSCDC officers were later found and taken to the hospital, while the boat driver is still missing.
On 28 November 2021, a woman was killed by unidentified armed men while on her way to her job at a church in Iwaro Oka (Akoko South West, Ondo). The reason for the attack is unknown.
On 28 November 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked Gidan Kaura near Gusau (Gusau LGA, Zamfara). Four people were killed.

On 28 November 2021, Nigerian troops supported by the air force repelled an attempt by ISWAP militants to infiltrate Gajiram (Nganzai, Borno) using gun trucks and other weapons. Several militants and two soldiers were killed, weapons and ammunition were seized by the troops and the remaining militants fled. Militant fatalities coded as 10. A total of 12 fatalities coded.
On 28 November 2021, presumed Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants attacked the Kumshe axis (Bama, Borno). There are no further details.

On 28 November 2021, a Zamfara militia attack was repelled by a Karazau militia group in Karazau (Gusau, Zamfara) as they attacked the city. 7 civilians were killed during the attack. The militia tried to attack the community for a second time while residents were conducting funeral prayers for the people killed in the attack earlier the day. Causalities in the second attack unknown.
On 28 November 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked and killed two civilians in Yar Tsakkuwa community (Gusau, Zamfara), coded as Wanke.

On 28 November 2021, unidentified armed men attacked the Kodi state commissioner for environment along the Ikoyi-Iyara road (Ijumu, Kogi). The commissioner was shot in the leg and an unspecified number of travelers were abducted.

On 28 November 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked the medium security custodial center in Jos (Jos North, Plateau) and were engaged in a clash by NCoS officers and other security forces. Not less than 11 persons, including one NCoS officer, one assailant and nine inmates were killed; one NCoS officer and 6 inmates were wounded while some of the assailants and 262 inmates escaped from the jail. 12 inmates were rearrested later.
On 28 November 2021, suspected sea pirates abducted six oil workers carrying out maintenance in Ogbokiri-Akassa (Brass, Bayelsa), coded as Akassa. There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 28 November 2021, police forces engaged an unidentified armed group in an armed clash at the group's hideout in Tsenom (Ukum, Benue), after trailing the group following their involvement in an attack on mourners in Logo on 13 November [coded separately]. Two of the armed men were killed, one was wounded and arrested by the police.

On 28 November 2021, members of Ezza communal militia numbering over sixty ambushed policemen and an Ebonyi state lawmaker who went to Igbuduoke village in Effium (Ohaukwu, Ebonyi) to investigate the abduction of three engineers by militias in the area. One police officer was killed, his body taken by the militia with another police officer; three others and the lawmaker were wounded. Heavy casualties also reported among militia members.
On 28 November 2021, policemen invaded Igbudoke community (Ohaukwu, Ebonyi), coded as Effium, shot sporadically and killed three people, looted properties and burnt not fewer than 38 houses.
On 29 November 2021, a Kaduna militia abducted an unspecified number of travelers between the Rijana and Akilbu villages (Kachia, Kaduna). There are no details about ransom demands yet.

On 29 November 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a couple from the village of Oriomipupa (Obokun, Osun), coded as Ibokun. The abductors demanded 37 million naira as ransom, the wife escaped on 3 December. The man was released on 10 December after a ransom of 2 million naira was paid.

On 29 November 2021, troops of security forces on patrol clashed with members of a Kaduna militia at an identified hideout in Birnin Gwari LGA (Kaduna) and Idasu [coded separately]. Two militia members were killed, weapons and three motorcycles were recovered

On 29 November 2021, soldiers foiled an attempt by IPOB militants to abduct some medical doctors and nurses and pursued the militants to Amauju (Isu, Imo), coded as Umundugba, where they clashed. One militant was killed, one other was arrested with gunshot wounds.

On 29 November 2021, troops of security forces on patrol clashed with members of a Kaduna militia at an identified hideout in Idasu (Giwa, Kaduna) and Birnin Gwari [coded separately]. Three militia members were killed, weapons and three motorcycles were recovered.

On 29 November 2021, a member of the Eiye cult militia attacked some hotel lodgers at Obantoko, Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun). The police responded to a distress call from the hotel, and he was arrested with a locally-fabricated double-barrelled shotgun with one expended cartridge.

On 29 November 2021, police forces repelled an attack by Yansakai militia on the Fulani settlement in Bargaja (Gusau, Zamfara). Three civilians were killed by the militia before the arrival of the police.
On 29 November 2021, military forces repelled an attack by ISWAP militants on Auno (Konduga, Borno). Causalities unknown.

On 29 November 2021, police forces intercepted and clashed with suspected Boko Haram militants who abducted travelers around the Yanakiri/Kondori village (Nganzai, Borno). 16 travelers, including an off duty soldier, were rescued, three travelers are still missing; Casualties are unknown.

On 29 November 2021, presumed Boko haram/ ISWAP militants ambushed commuters along Auno-Mainok road (Kaga, Borno) and abducted at least eight people. Security forces imposed a restriction on movement in the area due to the heightened presence of the militants.
On 29 November 2021, a Zamfara militia clashed with a Karazau militia when they returned to attack Karazau community (Gusau, Zamfara) for a third time. Causalities unknown.

On 29 November 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked a Fulani settlement in Barakallahu community at Igabi (Igabi, Kaduna). One person was killed, an undisclosed number of cows were stolen by the assailants.
On 30 November 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked a Fulani settlement in Ligari village (Chikun, Kaduna) and shot sporadically before they abducted one person and rustled many cows.

On 30 November 2021, at least 10 persons were killed and scores went missing in reprisal attacks by Fulani militias on Tiv villagers within the Bantaje Chiefdom in Gassol LGA (Taraba). According to the leader of the Bantaje Chiefdom, six other farmers were killed at the boundary between Gassol and Wukari LGAs. The attacks are believed to be a reprisal for the killing of a Fulani man after he was robbed by a tiv man.

Around 30 November 2021, (between 22 November- 30 November), a supremacy battle between the Black Axe and Eiye cult militias left six people dead in Okitipupa (Okitipupa, Ondo). Ten other militiamen were injured in the clash, which prompted the local government and other stakeholders to impose a curfew on the community (coded separately). 6 fatalities reported.

On 30 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants, enforcing a sit at home order, clashed with soldiers in Akata (Oru, Imo) and Mgbidi [coded separately]. The soldiers were deployed to contain the militants, casualties are unknown.

On 30 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants, enforcing a sit at home order, clashed with soldiers in Mgbidi (Oru West, Imo) and Akata [coded separately]. The soldiers were deployed to contain the militants, casualties are unknown.

On 30 November 2021, Nigerian troops, supported by the air force, and police repelled an attempt by ISWAP militants to infiltrate Buni Yadi (Gujba, Yobe) using gun trucks which were destroyed and some seized, while the militants fled after several others were killed. ISWAP claimed the attack and killing and injuring several soldiers. Fatalities coded as 10.
On 1 December 2021, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists killed a farmer near the Abuyab village, Atyap Chiefdom (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Zangon Katab.
On 1 December 2021, Tiv and Fulani ethnic militias clashed at Batanje community in Gassol LGA (Taraba). At least 11 persons were killed and an unspecified number of others were wounded.

On 1 December 2021, unidentified armed men, believed to be pirates, abducted four persons including an off duty NSCDC officer on their way to Koluama (Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa). The abductors demanded for a ransom of 25 million naira. The victims regained their freedom around 8 December after a search party was dispatched to rescue the victims.

On 1 December 2021, at least six persons were killed as a result of the clash between Black Axe and Eiye confraternity over supremacy in Okitipupa (Okitipupa, Ondo). The town was placed on a seven hour curfew to defuse tensions.

On 1 December 2021, armed men from a katsina militia invaded Fankama (Faskari, Katsina), and abducted the traditional ruler, his wife and many other villagers. There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 1 December 2021, suspected ISWAP militants abducted at least 15 people near Gumsuri (Damboa, Borno). The militants set up an illegal vehicle check point and were disguised in military uniform. The group took the victims into Sambisa forest, some of whom are humanitarian workers. There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

On 1 December 2021, ISWAP militants abducted at least five officials of the Borno state government supervising construction work near Wovi (Chibok, Borno). One of the victims escaped unhurt, the abductors also took three sand trucks. There are no reports about ransom demands.

Around 1 December 2021 (as reported), many women were raped, and the son of the district head of Amar and about 20 others were abducted by unidentified armed individuals around Amar (Karim Lamidu, Taraba), coded as Karim Lamido. There are no reports about ransom demands for the abducted persons.

On 2 December 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked Kanuwar Isa and Kugu, Zaria LGA (Kaduna), coded as Zaria. A former councilor of the ward was killed, nine persons were abducted from Kanuwar Isa and four from Kugu.
On 3 December 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked civilians at Ungwan Gimibiya community in Sabon Tasha (Chikun, Kaduna). Two people were killed and over fifty people were abducted.

On 3 December 2021, a truck driver was shot and killed by policemen, while his colleague sustained gunshot wounds, in Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun) after the truck had a traffic violation along the road and an argument ensued between the victim and the policemen who fled the scene.
On 3 December 2021, ISWAP launched an attack and clashed with Nigerian troops at Malam Fatori (Abadan, Borno). There are no further details. Causalities unknown.

On 3 December 2021, Nigerian troops assisted by the air force clashed with ISWAP militants that launched an attack on a military base in Rann (Kala Balge, Borno). Seven soldiers, including the commanding officer, and 24 militants were killed.

On 3 December 2021, policemen shot and wounded a presumed off duty DSS officer in Dakwa (Gwagwalada, FCT). The policemen, together with militiamen from the area, were on a raid in the area where they arrested about 37 residents, including traders, sellers and commercial drivers, who were all released the following day after paying 5000 naira as bail.

On 3 December 2021, at least four civilians were killed and an unspecified number of others sustained injuries when a katsina militia attacked Dugara, Daurawa and Gidan Gadi villages (Matazu, Katsina), coded as Matazu.

On 4 December 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted nine people, including four students of Delta state university, along the Abraka-Eku road (Ethiope East, Delta). A ransom of 5 million naira was demanded, the abductees were released on 8 December after security forces were deployed [no interaction reported], reports do not indicate whether ransom was paid.

On 4 December 2021, suspected a Niger militia, dressed in military uniform and mounted on motorcycles, fired indiscriminately at 2 vehicles carrying travelers along the Zungeru-Minna highway (Wushishi, Niger). Four persons were killed.

On 4 December 2021, policemen on patrol clashed with members of a Kaduna militia around Sabon Birnin Daji (Igabi, Kaduna). One 17 year old boy who was abducted by the militia was rescued while the militiamen fled with bullet wounds.

On 4 December 2021, suspected Fulani militiamen shot the councilor of Ward 17 Ovu-Inland, along the Abraka-Eku road (Ethiope East, Delta), coded as Abraka. The victim died in a hospital while receiving medical treatment in Warri.

On 4 December 2021, at least 7 travelers were abducted by Niger militia men along the Tegina-Zungeru road (Rafi, Niger). The victims were rescued by a combined team of soldiers and policemen on 8 December.

On 4 December 2021, members of a Niger militia blocked the Kontongora-Minna road near Kundu (Rafi, Niger), coded as Yakila, and abducted an unspecified number of persons. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 4 December 2021, policemen, together with hunters and DSS operatives, clashed with an unidentified armed group in Gwazari Hills (Song, Adamawa), coded as Song. Six abductees were rescued, one member of the armed group was killed; a weapon and 17 rounds of live ammunition were recovered.

On 4 December 2021, ISWAP militants claimed to have fired 6 mortar shells at the 1000 residential housing estate, Gomari and 777 housing estate in Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno). At least one house was damaged and one baby was wounded, the rockets were fired from the Duwari area. Other sources report that soldiers engaged the militants in an armed clash on the outskirts of Maiduguri.

On 4 December 2021, suspected members of an unidentified cult group killed a lawyer in Nung Ukana (Ibesikpo Asutan, Akwa Ibom). The victim's murder is linked to the struggle for village headship in the area.

On 4 December 2021, unidentified armed men clashed with a policemen attached to a private security company as they attacked a plantation and tried to steal latex in Ovia South West LGA (Edo), coded as Okomu. The policeman and an unarmed private security driver were wounded, the assailants fled when soldiers came as reinforcement.

On 5 December 2021, overnight members of a Kaduna militia attacked communities in Birnin Gwari LGA (Kaduna) and abducted 36 people, including women and children. There are no reports about demands for ransom.
On 5 December 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and killed a lecturer of the Benue state polytechnic along Ugbokolo - Eke expressway (Eke Okpokwu, Benue). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 5 December 2021, a joint team of hunters and Kogi militia members clashed with armed individuals and foiled an attempt to abduct travelers at Ahoko bridge along Abuja - Lokoja highway (Lokoja, Kogi). Two of the suspected abductors were arrested.

On 5 December 2021, at least four unidentified cult militiamen attacked shot and killed one person at his residence in Oke-Sokori, coded to Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun). The assailants cut the victim's left hand and took it away, they also stole his neighbors' mobile phones.

On 5 December 2021, local vigilantes from Arondizuogu repelled an attack by a militia of armed pastoralists (assumed Fulani) who attacked Arondizuogu (Ideato North, Imo), coded to Ndizuogu. Some of the assailants escaped with bullet wounds, one militia member was wounded.

On 5 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the district head of the Amar community (Karim Lamidu, Taraba), coded as Karim Lamido, from his residence. The abductors have demanded for a ransom of 25 million naira.

On 6 December 2021, armed pastoralists (assumed Fulani) and farmers clashed at Kasuwan Ladi village (Toungo, Adamawa), coded as Toungo. Two farmers and one pastoralist were killed, two other persons sustained injuries.

On 6 December 2021, a Kuna communal militia engaged a Niger militia in an armed clash at Kuna village, Kafin Koro district (Paikoro, Niger), after the Niger militia attacked the nearby villages of Nugwazi and Ruga, abducted about 8 Fulani persons, killed one and wounded one (coded separately). The abducted victims were rescued and scores (coded as 20) of Niger militiamen were killed, two escaped.

On 6 December 2021, a Niger militia attacked the nearby villages of Nugwazi and Ruga, coded to Kafin (Paikoro, Niger), and abducted around 8 Fulani persons, killed one and wounded one. A Kuna communal militia then engaged them in an armed clash at Kuna village. The abducted victims were rescued (coded separately).

On 6 December 2021, the Icelanders shot and killed a man in Inen, coded to Ikot Ibritam (Oruk Anam, Akwa Ibom), over the suspicion that the victim had bewitched one of the militia sons. The accuser and his gang dragged the victim out of his house, tied him to a tree and beheaded him. He later fled on a neighbour's motorcycle. 1 casualty was reported.

Around 6 December 2021 (as reported), nine persons were abducted by members of a Sokoto communal militia in Masawa village (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), coded as Sabon Birni. There are no reports about demands for ransom.

On 6 December 2021, members of a Sokoto militia ambushed a bus conveying travelers in Teke village of Gidan Bawa district of Sabon Birni LGA (Sokoto). The state government has confirmed 23 people were killed.
On 6 December 2021, military forces foiled an attempt by IPOB militants to attack Mgbidi and Awo-Omamma (Oru East, Imo) residents over a sit in order. The militants fled and were trailed by soldiers.
On 6 December 2021, a catholic priest was abducted by unidentified armed men along Akure - Ikere road in Akure South LGA (Ondo). The abductors demanded 20 million naira as ransom.
On 7 December 2021, armed pastoralists (assumed Fulani) armed with bows and arrows attacked farmers in Tila Kala Maina village (Gulami, Yobe), coded as Gulani. Two farmers were wounded.

Around 7 December 2021 (as reported), ISWAP militants and a Bakoura led faction of Boko Haram militants engaged in a gun battle over supremacy in the Lake Chad region. Many militants were killed. Location coded to Baga (Kukawa, Borno). Unknown fatalities coded as 10.
On 7 December 2021, presumed Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants clashed with Nigerian troops in the vicinity of Rumirigo (Askira Uba, Borno). There are no further details. Casualties unknown.
On 7 December 2021, unidentified armed men attacked Piri (Kwali, FCT) and abducted eight persons amid gunshots across attacks that occurred over two days.

On 7 December 2021, ISWAP militants [Lake Chad faction] attacked a police station in Buni Yadi (Gujba, Yobe). A police station, barracks and two operational vehicles were burnt. An unspecified number of policemen were wounded.

On 7 December 2021, a tanker driver was shot in the leg by a policeman close to the Asaba tollgate area of the Niger bridge (Oshimili South, Delta). The driver had attempted running away over fear of being beaten or arrested when he was shot.

Around 7 December 2021 (as reported), members of a Zamfara militia killed between six to seven civilians and abducted several others in an attack on motorists along Kaura Namoda - Shinkafi road (Shinkafi, Zamfara). The assailants set many vehicles and food items on fire. The recent attacks are said to be in revenge of the raid by military forces which killed several militia members or the continued closure of the livestock market in Shinkafi town.

On 8 December 2021, members of a Niger militia attacked and killed at least nine worshippers at a mosque in Ba'are (Mashegu, Niger), coded as Mashegu. Residents of the area claim 16 persons were killed and 12 others were injured.

On 8 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted nine travelers, including four students of Delta state university, on the Abraka-Eku road (Ethiope East, Delta). The abductors have demanded for 5 million naira ransom for the release of the students.

On 8 December 2021, two persons were killed, and an unspecified number were wounded, by unidentified armed individuals that attacked Etekuru (Ohaji, Imo). Several properties were also destroyed in the attack.
On 8 December 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted the Owelle (chief) of Nsukwa as he was returning to Ogidi Nsukwa (Aniocha South, Delta). There are no reports about demands for ransom.

On 8 December 2021, hunters clashed with an unidentified armed group of suspected abductors in a forest in the Irekpeni-Osara communities (Adavi, Kogi). Some of the suspects escaped with bullet wounds, while three were arrested.
On 8 December 2021, a commissioner in katsina state was killed by unidentified armed persons suspected to be assassins at his residence in Katsina (Katsina, Katsina). One suspect was arrested.

On 8 December 2021, unidentified armed men attacked Piri (Kwali, FCT), killed a woman and abducted a few people. The attack was the second on the community, the first took place the previous day. Overall, 8 people were abducted.

On 8 December 2021, an Evangelical pastor was killed by members of a Kaduna militia in Igabi LGA (Kaduna), coded as Igabi. The victim was abducted on 8 November and part of the 5 million naira demanded as a ransom was delivered.

On 8 December 2021, three militants, presumed Boko haram, were killed by soldiers in the Amuda-Agapalawa area (Gwoza, Borno). The soldiers were on a patrol in the area and got information of militant's activities in the area; weapons and ammunition were recovered by the troops.
On 9 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the traditional ruler of Mbutu ancient kingdom (Aboh Mbaise, Imo). There are no reports about demands for ransom.
Around 9 December 2021 (as reported), unidentified armed men abducted a man in Wase LGA (Plateau), coded to Wase. The victim was released after 5 million naira was paid as ransom.

On 9 December 2021, a traditional ruler in Ilorin was abducted by unidentified armed men when reaching Afon (Asa, Kwara). A ransom of 60 million naira was demanded, the victim was released on 16 December, reports do not indicate whether a ransom was paid.

On 9 December 2021, a Kaduna militia abducted an off duty policeman, his wife, and their daughter in Unguwan Bulus, Sabon Tasha (Chikun, Kaduna). A ransom of 2 million naira was paid to the abductors. The man was shot by the militiamen on 11 December (coded separately).
On 9 December 2021, members of a Sokoto militia attacked and killed three civilians in Kurawa (Sabon Birni, Sokoto). The assailants shot sporadically and also injured several people.
On 9 December 2021, unidentified armed men attacked Atta (Njaba, Imo) and killed four persons. The traditional ruler of the community was also abducted and his body was found the next morning.

Around 9 December 2021 (as reported), Nigerian troops launched an operation and rescued 20 policemen captured by ISWAP during an attack on Buni Yadi (Gujba, Yobe), although the location of the rescue operation is not clear. Clashes assumed. The Yobe state command of the police force denied the claims and insisted that no policeman was abducted.

Around 9 December 2021 (as reported), policemen clashed with an unidentified armed group that abducted three persons in Piri community (Kwali, FCT). Two out of the three victims were rescued, two of the abductors were arrested while the others fled.

On 10 December 2021, a group of hunters clashed with an unidentified armed group and rescued five abducted travelers in a forest near the Osara community (Adavi, Kogi). One of the abductees and some of the abductors were wounded in the clash.

On 10 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted four persons, including a retired senior civil servant, at Anguwan Baraya in Jalingo metropolis (Jalingo, Taraba). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 10 December 2021, a Sokoto militia abducted four persons, including a chief Imam, at Gatawa (Sabon Birni, Sokoto). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 10 December 2021, ISWAP militants attacked a CJTF base in Mainok (Kaga, Borno) and killed two officers. The assailants disguised themselves as military men and arrived in what looked like a convoy. Other CJTF operatives fled.

Around 10 December 2021 (between 1 - 21 December), Nigerien and Nigerian MNJTF forces conducted a joint operation targeting Boko Haram (JAS) and ISWAP (Lake Chad) militants in the areas of Arege (Abadan, Borno) and Gashigar, Asaga, and Kamagunma (Mobbar, Borno). 6 soldiers were killed, 23 others wounded, and two vehicles damaged in the operation. 22 militants were killed, 4 vehicles destroyed, 5 motorcycles burned, 1 rocket ramp and logistic plots destroyed, and weapons seized by the joint force. Fatalities are split across four events on 10 December. The fatalities of the joint force are coded in previously reported events.

Around 10 December 2021 (between 1 - 21 December), Nigerien and Nigerian MNJTF forces conducted a joint operation targeting Boko Haram (JAS) and ISWAP (Lake Chad) militants in the areas of Asaga (Mobbar, Borno), Arege (Abadan, Borno) and Gashigar and Kamagunma (Mobbar, Borno). 6 soldiers were killed, 23 others wounded, and two vehicles damaged in the operation. 22 militants were killed, 4 vehicles destroyed, 5 motorcycles burned, 1 rocket ramp and logistic plots destroyed, and weapons seized by the joint force. Around 10 December 2021 (between 1 - 21 December), Nigerien and Nigerian MNJTF forces conducted a joint operation targeting Boko Haram (JAS) and ISWAP (Lake Chad) militants in the areas of Gashigar (Mobbar, Borno), Arege (Abadan, Borno), and Asaga and Kamagunma (Mobbar, Borno). 6 soldiers were killed, 23 others wounded, and two vehicles damaged in the operation. 22 militants were killed, 4 vehicles destroyed, 5 motorcycles burned, 1 rocket ramp and logistic plots destroyed, and weapons seized by the joint force. Fatalities are split across four events on 10 December. The fatalities of the joint force are coded in previously reported events.

Fatalities are split across four events on 10 December. The fatalities of the joint force are coded in previously reported events.

On 11 December 2021, Kaduna militiamen shot and killed an off-duty policeman in Kaduna state. The victim was abducted together with his wife and daughter on 9 December in Unguwan Bulus, Sabon Tasha (Chikun, Kaduna) [coded separately]. It is unclear where exactly he was killed.

On 11 December 2021, members of a Kaduna militia abducted a woman and four of her children at their residence in Oil Village in Sabon Tasha (Chikun, Kaduna). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

On 11 December 2021, military forces foiled an abduction attempt by a Kaduna militia and engaged the militiamen in a clash at Sabon Tasha community (Chikun, Kaduna). The assailants set a house on fire. Casualties are unknown.

On 11 December 2021, members of an unidentified cult militia attacked and shot a student over his refusal to join their group in Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun). The victim was also set ablaze by the assailants before he was rescued and taken to the hospital, other sources claim the victim is a cult member and was attacked by a rival group.
On 11 December 2021, members of a Sokoto militia attacked Dama village (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), coded as Gatawa, and shot and wounded a woman on her leg.

On 11 December 2021, policemen beat up a man in Elimgbu police station (Obio, Rivers) as he reported a kidnapping, demanded that they do their jobs and refused to provide the money they asked for. The victim was also threatened with a gun by the policemen.

On 11 December 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted an unspecified number of people, including a retired group general manager of the NNPC, along the Lafia-Abuja road (Lafia, Nassarawa). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 11 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a couple at Umuobasi Ukwu, near Aba (Aba South, Abia). There are no reports on ransom demands yet.
On 11 December 2021, a Sokoto militia blocked the Sabon Birni - Gatawa road (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), shot and injured three persons and abducted seven others.

On 11 December 2021, unidentified armed men attacked, inflicted machete cuts on a farmer and abducted a trader at Iyemero Ekiti (Ikole, Ekiti), coded as Ikole. The abductors have demanded 6 million naira as ransom.

On 11 December 2021, military forces, in collaboration with CJTF, foiled an attack on civilians by a Zamfara militia in Karakai (Bungudu, Zamfara). Seven civilians were killed by the militiamen before the arrival of soldiers, 20 militiamen were killed during the clash with soldiers; scores of arms, ammunition and motorcycles were recovered.

On 12 December 2021, members of a Sokoto militia abducted no fewer than 20 locals from Chacho (Wurno, Sokoto) and Kwasare [coded separately]. The attacks took place simultaneously. Countless domestic animals and motorcycles belonging to residents were stolen. There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.
On 12 December 2021, unidentified armed men numbering up to twelve invaded Pakri grain market in Bali LGA (Taraba) and abducted three grain merchants. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 12 December 2021, unidentified armed men attacked civilians and shot sporadically in Pinau (Wase, Plateau), coded as Wase. Between 9 and 10 persons were killed, four to several others were wounded.

On 12 December 2021, police officers repelled an attack and clashed with a Niger militia in Wamba village (Mariga, Niger), coded as Mariga. The militiamen fled and reinforced to attack the same village and were repelled again; they fled with bullet injuries, three motorcycles were recovered by the police.

On 12 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a couple, while their daughter escaped, in Kokori (Ethiope East, Delta). The man is the current chairman of the Delta State Chapter of National Association of Proprietors of Private Schools; the abductors demanded for 200 million naira as ransom, the victims were released around 19 December after 12 million naira was paid.

On 12 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the traditional rulers of Amagu Ihube and Ihitte Ihube, and the youth leader of Umuololo-Okigwe in Okigwe LGA (Imo), coded to Okigwi. The houses and cars of the victims were vandalized by the assailants; the abductors demanded a 20 million naira ransom. The ruler of Amagu Ihube was rescued on 13 December, reports do not metion whether a ransom was paid or security forces secured his release.
On 12 December 2021, members of a Kaduna militia killed one person along the Kaduna-Zaria expressway (Kaduna North, Kaduna), coded to Kaduna.

On 12 December 2021, ISWAP clashed with hunters/vigilantes in Debiro community (Hawul, Borno), coded as Azare. ISWAP claimed to have killed one member of the militia and burnt a christian church. Other sources report that they looted foodstuff and livestock without inflicting any casualties and were repelled by hunters. ISWAP claimed the attack.

On 12 December 2021, members of a Sokoto militia abducted no fewer than 20 locals from Kwasare (Wurno, Sokoto) and Chacho [coded separately]. The attacks took place simultaneously, there are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 13 December 2021, policemen clashed with members of a Kaduna militia around Riheyi village in Fatika district (Giwa, Kaduna). Two militia members were killed; a gun, 10 rounds of ammunition and a motorcycle were recovered by the policemen.

On 13 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a medical doctor from his private hospital in Yola (Yola-North, Adamawa). The abductors have demanded for an undisclosed huge sum of money; the victim was released on 17 December, there are no reports on ransom payment

On 13 December 2021, a Kaduna militia killed a member of the Kaduna House of Assembly and two other persons at the Gonar Magajin Gari village along the Kaduna-Zaria expressway (Kaduna North, Kaduna), coded to Kaduna. Dozens of travelers were abducted by the assailants.

On 13 December 2021, suspected ISWAP militants clashed with Hunters during an attack in Shallangba village, Hawul LGA (Borno), coded as Azare, shooting esporadically while villagers fled. Sources state that the militants overpowered local hunters in the area. Casualties are unknown.
On 13 December 2021, presumed ISWAP (Lake Chad) militants ambushed a Nigerien army patrol near the town of Gashigar (Mobbar, Borno). Five soldiers were killed and about ten wounded.

On 13 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the mother of the Chief of Staff to the Kogi State Governor from her residence in Nagazi community (Adavi, Kogi), coded as Ogaminana. There are no reports about demands for ransom.

On 13 December 2021, policemen repelled an attack by suspected BNG militants dressed in military camouflage and using a gun truck on the police headquarters in Umuahia (Umuahia North, Abia). One policeman was killed, an unspecified number of assailants fled with bullet wounds. The Biafran National Guard claimed responsibility for the attack.

On 14 December 2021, policemen clashed with an unidentified armed group in New Layout Nkaliki, Abakaliki LGA (Ebonyi), coded as Abakaliki. One victim who was abducted by the group was rescued by the policemen, one member of the group was killed.

Around 14 December 2021 (as reported), members of a Niger militia killed two out of the three victims in captivity, abducted from Tegina (Rafi, Niger), one of whom was a factory worker and the other, an officer in charge of immunization in the area.

On 14 December 2021, Kaduna militiamen killed a staff member of the Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) whom they abducted three weeks ago after his family paid 7 million naira to secure his release. Location coded as Kaduna (Kaduna North, Kaduna).

On 14 December 2021, the Nigerian arm claimed to have ambushed ISWAP militants and engaged them in an armed clash at Sabongari Chambula (Madagali, Adamawa). Six militants were killed, several others fled with gunshot injuries; weapons and ammunitions were recovered. ISWAP claimed the attack, the killing of 10 soldiers, the seizure of two vehicles and brief control of the town before withdrawing.

On 14 December 2021, an unidentified armed group, presumed to be a cult militia, killed three persons, including two policemen from the Anti-Cult department in Awka (Awka South, Anambra). The police officers were escorting the leader of tricycle riders in Awka North and South who was abducted during the clash at the Nnamdi Azikiwe university temporary site. One woman was hit and injured by a stray bullet.

On 15 December 2021, members of a Kaduna militia attacked two communities in Dutsen Abba (Zaria, Kaduna) and abducted residents. Two persons were abducted from Dallatu; six others, including three children, were abducted from Kasuwar Da'a. The children were released hours later, there are no reports about ransom demands.
Around 15 December 2021 (as reported), a patrol team found two corpses in the Kurfi-Magamiya general area (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna). The victims are presumed to have been killed by a Kaduna militia.
Around 15 December 2021 (as reported), Kaduna militiamen killed two civilians in Sako village (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna).

Around 15 December 2021 (as reported), Kaduna militiamen barricaded the Buruku-Udawa section of the Kaduna-Birnin Gwari road (Chikun, Kaduna) and killed three civilians. One person sustained gunshot wounds and was taken to the hospital.
Around 15 December 2021 (month of), suspected militia members killed one Chinese national and abducted two others from the Zungeru Hydro power plant (Wushishi, Niger).
On 15 December 2021, armed men from a Kaduna militia attacked Sayen Lemu village (Zaria, Kaduna). One man was killed and three of his children were abducted.

On 15 December 2021, ISWAP claimed to have killed many Nigerian soldiers with a suicide vehicle borne improvised explosive device which rammed into a military convoy in Malam Fatori (Abadan, Borno). The militants claimed some military vehicles including a MRAP were destroyed. Unknown fatalities coded as 10.

On 15 December 2021, unidentified armed men suspected to be assassins shot and killed a quarter Chief in Owo (Owo, Ondo) over an alleged land dispute. Another person was hit by the victim's bullet and wounded.
On 15 December 2021, ISWAP (Lake Chad) claimed to have clashed with a Nigerien and Nigerian joint patrol and wounded several soldiers near the town of Duji (Mobbar, Borno).

On 15 December 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the traditional ruler of Umuezeala Ama autonomous community at Nkwo-Umuezeala market square, Ehime Mbano LGA (Imo), coded as Umueze. The victim was released on 22 December, an undisclosed amount was paid as ransom.
Around 15 December 2021 (as reported), Kaduna militiamen killed one resident and injured another at the Yola-Kadi general area of Chikun LGA (Kaduna).

Around 16 December 2021 (as reported), an unidentified armed group killed the traditional ruler of Ihitte Ihube and the youth leader of Umulolo Okigwe in Orsu LGA (Imo), coded as Awo-Idemili. Their bodies were found by security forces who raided the assailants' hideout after they were abducted on 12 December.
On 16 December 2021, unidentified armed men killed at least three men returning from their farm along the Ore Egbeba road of Apa-Agila ward (Ado, Benue). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 16 December 2021, Nigerian military forces and a local Katanga militia clashed with members of a Sokoto militia in Katanga village (Isa, Sokoto), coded as Isa. The troops were supported by NAF fighter jets and several Sokoto bandits were killed. Several fatalities coded as 3.

On 16 December 2021, Zamfara militiamen attacked, wounded and abducted an unspecified number of residents in Nasarawa (Bukkuyum, Zamfara). The attack was for punishing the locals for assisting a Nigerian military outpost.

On 17 December 2021, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists attacked Tiv farmers in Awe LGA (Nassarawa), Obi and Lafia LGAs [coded separately] in reprisal of the discovery of the body of their kinsman in a community in the Obi LGA. Between 20 to 45 farmers were killed in the attacks which lasted from 17 to 19 December; 27 others were wounded and up to 5000 persons were displaced. 20 fatalities split across 9 events.

On 17 December 2021, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists attacked Tiv farmers in Obi LGA (Nassarawa), Lafia and Awe LGAs [coded separately] in reprisal of the discovery of the body of their kinsman in a community in the Obi LGA. Between 20 to 45 farmers were killed in the attacks which lasted from 17 to 19 December; 27 others were wounded and up to 5000 persons were displaced. 20 fatalities split across 9 events.

On 3 January 2022, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists abducted a woman from her pastor's house in Ngyong community, Bokkos LGA (Plateau). There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

Around 5 January 2022 (as reported), members of the Yamasaki militia killed four suspected informants of Zamfara militiamen in Kaura Namoda town (Kaura Namoda, Zamfara).

On 6 January 2022, unidentified individuals attacked civilians in Yandang and Fulani communities in Lau LGA (Taraba). Five people were killed.
