On 20 September 2022, an unidentified armed group shot a woman at Ologuneru, Ibadan (Ibadan North West LGA, Oyo state). She was shot twice at close range but was later taken to the hospital for treatment. No further details.

On 20 September 2022, a Zamfara militia attacked civilians in Ajiyawa and Tobali villages, coded to Shinkafi (Shinkafi, Zamfara). At least 4 persons were killed and an unspecified number were wounded.

On 21 September 2022, suspected Fulani herders launched simultaneous attacks on Mou village (Logo, Benue) and Mchia [coded separately]. Three people were killed and 15 others including children were wounded, the police claimed that 10 persons were killed and 8 were wounded in the attacks.

On 21 September 2022, suspected Fulani herders launched simultaneous attacks on Mchia coded to Ugba (Logo, Benue) and Mou [coded separately]. 12 people were killed and 15 others including children were wounded, the police claimed that 10 persons were killed and 8 were wounded in the attacks.

On 21 September 2022, Nigerian troops clashed with Benue Communal militia members trying to attack Ortese and Ukoholin, coded to Ndzorov (Guma, Benue). An unspecified number of the militiamen were killed and their bodies were taken away by the other militiamen. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 21 September 2022, an unidentified armed group of about nine assailants attempted to assassinate and wounded an NNPP candidate for Nassarawa state house of assembly while he was on his way from Doma town (Doma, Nassarawa). The victim was also a former APC member and a commissioner.
Around 21 September 2022 (as reported), ISWAP claimed to have clashed with soldiers, killed two of them and wounded others at a checkpoint in Buratai (Biu, Borno).
On 21 September 2022, troops of sector 3 of the MNJTF repelled an attack by ISWAP fighters in Monguno (Monguno, Borno). The armed clash lasted for two hours, there are no further details.

On 21 September 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked the Criminal Investigation Department office of the Abia State police command at Umuagu (Umuahia North LGA, Abia). The assailants shot and wounded two police officers, cut another one with machetes, looted the police armory and went away with some rifles. No fatality was reported. The Abia state police command claimed that 3 rifles were stolen by the assailants, the attacked officers were conducting a stop and search in front of the facility and the facility itself was not attacked.

Around 21 September 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group abducted the village head of Bengo (Fufore, Adamawa) from his residence and demanded for a ransom of 40 million naira. The abductee was murdered by the assailants after the collected a ransom of 2 million naira and also abducted the person who went to deliver the ransom [coded separately].
On 21 September 2022, a Zamfara militia shot at an ambulance traveling along Kaura Namoda-Shinkafi road (Shinkafi, Zamfara). There are no further details.
On 21 September 2022, ISWAP claimed to have fired machine guns at the police vehicle in Ipele (Owo, Ondo), damaging the car. There were no fatality. the police denied the claims.
On 21 September 2022, Nigerian troops and the Civilian JTF ambushed Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants and engaged them in an armed clash at Kayamla (Konduga, Borno). Fatalities coded as 6.

Around 21 September 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group abducted an air force officer [presumed to be off duty] at Eke Agbani, coded Agbani (Nkanu West, Enugu). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 22 September 2022, policemen on patrol in collaboration with a local self defense militia responded to a distress call and clashed with an unidentified armed group that abducted two civilians from their farms in Ago-Orio community (Uhunmwode, Edo) coded to Obadan. The abductees were rescued, one of the assailants was killed while the others fled; a gun, machetes and one torchlight were recovered.

On 22 September 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted three policemen at Wasimi (Ewekoro, Ogun). The driver of the vehicle in which they were travelling escaped, the policemen were in Ogun for an investigation, the state police command claimed that only one policeman was abducted; the policemen were released, the police insisted only one policeman was abducted. They were released after a rescue team moved into the area.

On 22 September 2022, a Kaduna militia attacked some chieftains of the APC, wounded three people, killed two, and abducted others at Tashar Icce near Kujama (Chikun, Kaduna). The victims were coming back from a political meeting in Kujama, other sources report that two other buses were attacked around the same time, two persons were killed and others were abducted.

On 22 September 2022, members of the Iharev community and Kparev clashed in Tse-Sho Village, coded to Tyo (Makurdi LGA, Benue). The clash was the renewal of a land dispute in the community, which led to the abduction of three people and the death of two others. Houses were also burnt down. 2 fatalities were reported

On 22 September 2022, a Katsina militia attacked civilians, killed one person and rustled livestock from Garin Ajiya in Batsari LGA (Katsina). The assailants also stole valuables including computers, phones and from food stores.

On 22 September 2022, ISWAP claimed an attack on a police vehicle along Ibillo-Igarra road (Akoko Edo, Edo), killed one policeman and destroyed a vehicle. The police denied the claims and insisted that the assailants were an unidentified armed group who were on a reprisal attack .
Around 22 September 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group abducted a businessman at Agbani (Nkanu West, Enugu). The abductee was released after a ransom of 15 million naira was paid.

On 23 September 2022, a Zamfara militia who rode on motorcycles attacked worshippers observing prayers at a mosque in Ruwan Jema town, coded to Bukuyum (Bukkuyum, Zamfara) and killed between 11 to 15 persons. Many other persons sustained injuries, other sources report that some of the victims who were in the mosque were missing.

On 23 September 2022, an unidentified armed group ambushed a commercial vehicle and abducted the occupants at Abia Palm, coded to Utu Etim Ekpo (Etim Ekpo, Akwa Ibom). The abductors hijacked the bus and drove it to their hideout with 5 abductee whom they robbed, the abductee were rescued by security operatives [coded separately].

On 23 September 2022, Nigerian navy ratings invaded the residence of a civilian and beat him up in Agale, coded to Badagry (Badagry, Lagos) following a misunderstanding. The victim was arrested and released the following morning, he sustained varying degrees of injuries from the attack.

On 23 September 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked and shot at the car of a former Bauchi state APC gubernatorial aspirant who claimed the assailants trailed his car to Akwanga (Akwanga, Nassarawa). The assailants robbed the occupants of the car and fled.

On 23 September 2022, an unidentified armed group ambushed and abducted five to six civilians who were returning to Gurdi (Abaji, FCT) from Tekepeshe community. The abductors also snatched six motorcycles. A ransom of 8 million was demanded for four of the abductees.

On 23 September 2022, ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants abducted 5 people and stole valuables including food supplies at an illegal vehicle checkpoint at Mile 40 along Maiduguri-Gajiram road (Nganzai, Borno). Soldiers were deployed to the area [there are no reports about a clash].

On 24 September 2022, a Kaduna militia attacked civilians, killed three persons and abducted 18 others from Hayin Gada community and farm center along Birnin Gwrai-Kaduna road (Birnin Gwari, Kaduna). The assailants also looted shops in Hayin Gada. The six persons who were abducted from Farm Center were released around 30 September after paying for their ransom in measures of foodstuff.

On 24 September 2022, Boko Haram (JAS) ambushed Nigerian soldiers and engaged them in an armed clash along Maiduguri-Damboa highway (Maiduguri Metro, Borno). The soldiers were escorting commercial vehicles to Falouja village, the militants also used an RPG in the attack, one soldier was killed and three others were wounded and evacuated to Damboa.

On 24 September 2022, ISWAP in large numbers attacked security agents and overpowered them at Pompom Baliya village, 5 kilometers away from Gubio (Gubio, Borno) One policeman, 4 civilian JTF members and 3 hunters were abducted, the militants stole one patrol vehicle and headed towards Gadai village. ISWAP claimed the attack, other sources report that the claim is false and the militants fled leaving their abductees behind.

On 24 September 2022, ISWAP claimed to have attacked and killed two Igbo traders at Sabon Gari (Fagge, Kano). One victim was killed instantly while the second was chased and shot in the leg later died in the hospital, the militants claimed the victims were spies of the Nigerian army.

On 24 September 2022, a Niger militia abducted a woman and her female domestic staff when they broke into their residence around the Niger motel in Jepap, Suleja (Suleja, Niger). One man was also abducted by the assailants, other sources report that the woman had a misunderstanding with a man who had threatened to show her his reaction. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 24 September 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to be politically motivated attacked and shot at members of Labor party who were holding a meeting at Nomeh (Nkanu East, Enugu). The assailants accused the victims of bringing ''Fulani to Biafraland'', chairs and canopies at the venue were destroyed while the party members fled.
On 24 September 2022, a Kaduna militia abducted four civilians from Dajin Jangali and stole 3 motorcycles from farmers at Kamfanin Doka (Birnin Gwari, Kaduna).
On 24 September 2022, a Zamfara militia invaded a residence and abducted one person at Dunba (Gusau, Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 25 September 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked civilians in Jannaret town (Mangu, Plateau), killed one person and wounded two others. The assailants shot at the victims at the spot where a local self defense militia were known to visit; the targeted persons were not at the spot when it was attacked.

On 25 September 2022, a Zamfara militia killed three civilians and abducted eight nursing mothers from Tauji area of Kanoma north (Maru, Zamfara). The assailants invaded the area on motorcycles and shot to scare residents away before conducting a house to house search, the murdered victims had attempted to escape.

On 25 September 2022, policemen invaded the camp of an unidentified armed group that had abducted one person from Kara bridge and engaged them in an armed clash. Location coded to Mowe (Obafemi, Ogun), one of the assailants was arrested, others fled with bullet wounds and the abductee was rescued.

On 25 September 2022, ISWAP attacked a hunters unit and were engaged in an armed clash at Ngwom (Mafa, Borno). The clash lasted for at least 1 hour, the militants were repelled, the hunters did not record injuries or missing weapons.

On 25 September 2022, ISWAP claimed to have attacked the headquarters of a militia presumed to be Civilian JTF in Muna, coded to Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno), wounded a number of operatives and seized four of their rifles. Other sources denied the claims and reported that militants clashed with hunters at Mafa [coded separately].

On 25 September 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted the Bokkos LGA PDP chairman from his residence in Tangu (Bokkos, Plateau). He was rescued a few hours later after policemen and a local self defense militia pursued the abductors [there are no reports about a clash].
On 25 September 2022, a Katsina militia abducted one woman from a farm at Dabaibayawa village (Batagarawa, Katsina). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 25 September 2022, suspected Fulani pastoralists killed one civilian in Bangai (Riyom, Plateau).

On 26 September 2022, policemen in collaboration with soldiers invaded the hideout of an unidentified armed group and engaged them in an armed clash at Ikpe Annang, coded to Utu Etim Ekpo (Etim Ekpo, Akwa Ibom). The group had hijacked a bus and abducted 5 civilians [coded separately] who were rescued by the policemen. Two of the group members were arrested; the leader fled and the camp was set ablaze, other sources report that two of the assailants were killed and others fled with bullet wounds.
On 26 September 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted the paramount ruler of Tal chiefdom from his palace in Pankshin LGA (Plateau). A ransom of 50 million naira was demanded.

Around 26 September 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group abducted the son of a member of the Bauchi state house of assembly representing Dass, together with his two wives and child. The man was murdered by the abductees a few days later [coded separately] while his wives and child were released. There are no reports about ransom payment, location coded to Bauchi (Bauchi, Bauchi).

On 26 September 2022, a policeman attempted to repel an attack by a Katsina militia that was chasing a commercial bus at Makera village along Katsina-Jibia road (Jibia, Katsina). The policeman was overpowered by the assailants who killed him and burnt his vehicle, an unspecified number of commuters were abducted. Some sources report that the policeman was on his way to work when he was ambushed by the assailants, others report that the assailants ambushed a security outpost and killed the policeman.

Around 26 September 2022 (as reported), ISWAP fighters engaged Civilian JTF operatives in an armed clash, killed one operative and wounded 4 others when they raided Benisheikh (Kaga, Borno). Four patrol vehicles were set ablaze by the militants. ISWAP claimed that 6 Civilian JTF operatives were killed and four vehicles were destroyed. The police claimed that 6 security operatives including one policeman, hunters and Civilian JTF operatives, were abducted by the militants; the abductees escaped with the support of the air task force, after the militants fled on sighting the air craft.

Around 26 September 2022 (as reported), soldiers of the Nigerian army fired several artilleries at ISWAP militants who had gathered for a meeting at Wulle, coded to Damaturu (Damaturu, Yobe) and killed an unspecified number of militants. Other militants returned on 6 motorcycles and one vehicle to evacuate the corpses. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 27 September 2022, a Kaduna militia killed a farmer in Shiwaka community, Birnin Gwari LGA (Kaduna). The victim was tied to a tree till he died.

On 27 September 2022, a local self defense militia with help from defense militias from neighboring settlements ambushed a Zamfara militia that was on its way to carry out an attack on Kanoma town (Maru, Zamfara). 31 of the assailants were killed, an unspecified number escaped with serious wounds. The assailants returned to evacuate the dead bodies and burnt some others.

On 27 September 2022, Boko Haram (JAS) attacked a local self defense militia and engaged them in an armed clash in Kirawa, along the road to Pulka (Gwoza, Borno). Two vehicles belonging to the militia were set ablaze, no casualties were reported.

On 27 September 2022, an unidentified armed group on a fast moving motorcycle shot a student of FUNAAB at the Isolu-Cele area, coded to Odeda (Odedah, Ogun). NANS claimed that the victim was shot by unidentified policemen and the victim's whereabouts and progress were unknown to them. The police denied the claims.

On 27 September 2022, a Kaduna militia engaged soldiers on a patrol in an armed clash along Birnn Gwari-Gayam-Kuriga-Manini axis (Birnin Gwari, Kaduna). The assailants fled and left seven abductees who were rescued by the troops.

On 27 September 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked Igangan police station (Ibarapa North, Oyo). A divisional crime officer and a detainee were killed, one policeman and some detainees sustained gun injuries in the attack.

On 27 September 2022, an unidentified armed group in three cars attacked an army checkpoint and engaged soldiers and policemen in an armed clash at Obeagu Ugwuaji- Amodu road (Enugu South, Enugu). Some sources report that 3 soldiers and two policemen were killed while 3 soldiers fled with varying degrees of injuries, others report that two soldiers were killed. Civilians in the area fled dur to fear of being targeted by security agents.

On 27 September 2022, a Niger militia attacked civilians, killed 15 persons and abducted others from Mohuro community in Mariga LGA (Niger). The village head who was one of the murdered victims was targeted because he hindered the payment of 50 million naira to the militiamen by the community , the amount was demanded to enable the locals harvest their farm produce.
On 27 September 2022, troops of Operation Hadin Kai killed two Boko Haram (JAS) militants in the axis Dalori (Jere, Borno).

On 27 September 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked Iganna police station (Iwajowa, Oyo). A divisional crime officer and a detainee were killed, one policeman and some detainees sustained gun injuries in the attack. The police claimed one policeman and one civilian were killed, two others were seriously wounded.

On 27 September 2022, a policeman shot a driver in the leg at Iganna (Iwajowa, Oyo) following a disagreement over bribe which the driver refused to pay at a checkpoint. The driver was dragging the policeman's gun with him. The attack led youths in the area to attack a police station [coded separately].

On 27 September 2022, a suspected unidentified cult militia attacked and killed a civilian in his pub at Sawmill area of Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). The assailants first smashed the victim's head with a bottle before he was shot at close range, the reason for the attack is unknown.
On 27 September 2022, Boko Haram [JAS] militants ambushed a vehicle that was transporting goods along Liman-Mora road Gwoza LGA (Borno). No casualties were reported.
On 28 September 2022, a Kaduna militia abducted an unspecified number of commuters when they blocked the highway at Tashar Icce, coded to nearby Kujama (Chikun, Kaduna).
On 28 September 2022, an unidentified armed group killed one farmer in Iorzaa in (Buruku, Benue).

On 28 September 2022, Boko Haram (JAS) ambushed troops of Operation Hadin Kai at Yaleri village along Damboa road (Damboa, Borno). The troops were escorting commercial vehicles, there are no casualties on the side of the troops, traces of blood along the route indicates that some of the militants were wounded.
On 28 September 2022, a Niger militia abducted some women when they attacked Unguwan Gwari in Lapai LGA (Niger). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 28 September 2022, a Kaduna militia abducted over 20 people from different farms in Jangali and Kwaga (Birnin Gwari, Kaduna). There are no reports about ransom demands.

Around 28 September 2022, an unidentified armed group killed the son of a member of the Bauchi state house of assembly representing Dass, whom they had abducted a few days earlier [coded separately]. Location coded to Bauchi (Bauchi, Bauchi).

On 28 September 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted the youth chairman of Sapele-Okpe community at Sapele (Sapele, Delta). The abductee went to play football when the abductors invaded the area and shot sporadically before taking him away. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 28 September 2022, an unidentified armed group ambushed soldiers who were on a patrol and engaged them in an armed clash near Nkwo market at Enugu Umunze (Orumba South, Anambra). Five soldiers were killed, one civilian was killed by stray bullets. Some sources report that two civilians were also killed, others report that between 2 to 4 soldiers and one unidentified person were killed. Fatalities coded as 2. IPOB denied responsibility for the attack and accused the Nigerian army of linking the group to the attack out of hatred.
On 28 September 2022, ISWAP claimed to have attacked an army checkpoint in Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno). Other sources denied the claims and insisted no attacks took place.

On 28 September 2022, an unidentified armed group numbering about 15 attacked a military checkpoint and engaged the soldiers in an armed clash at Mgbidi (Oru West. Imo). Two of the assailants and one soldier were killed, the assailants stole a GPMG from the soldiers.

On 28 September 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted 10 persons including 3 housewives and 7 men from Bwaje in Abaji (FCT). The abductors shot sporadically to scare residents, conducted house to house searches, burgled some shops where they stole foodstuff and other valuables.

On 28 September 2022, a Zamfara militia suspected to be loyal to Dan Karami ambushed soldiers who were responding to a distress call from residents of Yar Dole in Kaura Namoda LGA (Zamfara). 3 soldiers were killed and an unspecified number were wounded, other sources report that one soldier was wounded, an unspecified number of assailants were killed and their corpses were taken away by their colleagues.

On 28 September 2022, NSCDC operatives clashed with an unidentified armed group of 8 that attempted to abduct a foreigner from his farm in Ibadan (Ibadan North West, Oyo). One of the assailants was killed.

On 28 September 2022, troops of Operation Forest Sanity raided the hideout of a Kaduna militia and engaged them in an armed clash at the boundary between Chikun and Birnin Gwari (Chikun, Kaduna). The militiamen fled with gunshot wounds, and abandoned three abductees who were rescued by the troops who also recovered arms and ammunition.
On 28 September 2022, an unidentified armed group killed a staff of INEC whom they abducted, the victim's body was found along Isu-Aniocha-Urum road (Awka North, Anambra) on 29 September.

On 29 September 2022, Nigerian troops invaded an enclave of Boko Haram militants [JAS Faction] and killed an unspecified number of militants in Bula Dawo, Bama LGA (Borno). One abductee was rescued with two of her children. Fatalities coded as 3.
On 29 September 2022, a Katsina militia blocked the feeder road between Kuka and Kirtawa villages in Safana LGA (Katsina) and abducted two civilians. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 29 September 2022, scores of a Katsina militia on motorcycles attacked a joint security checkpoint along Katsina-Jibia road (Jibia, Katsina) and killed one customs operative and snatched the service rifle of another operative.

On 29 September 2022, soldiers shot sporadically and wounded several people when they invaded Enugu Umunze (Orumba South, Anambra) in reprisal over an attack on soldiers the previous day [coded separately]. House and shops, including Nkwo market were sacked, some were set ablaze and some persons were critically wounded. Other sources report that one person was killed.
On 29 September 2022, ISWAP militants attacked and killed an operative of Civilian JTF when they invaded his house in Nganzai, coded to Gajiram (Nganzai, Borno). ISWAP claimed the attack.

On 29 September 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked a store owner who was also a Muslim cleric with machetes and killed him at his residence in the Alubarika area of Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). Two of the victim's children were also abducted and a ransom of 10 million naira was demanded. The abductees escaped after their abductors fell asleep.
On 29 September 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants fired indiscriminately in the vicinity of Wurge (Ngala, Borno). There are no further details.

Around 30 September 2022 (as reported), a suspected Fulani militia attacked a woman, killed her baby and left her critically wounded along Kadamti village (Numan, Adamawa). The woman is a student pastor of the Redeemed Christian Church of God and was on her way to a funeral.
On 30 September 2022, a Niger militia abducted 7 residents of Ajiji community in Lapai LGA (Niger). There are no reports on ransom demands.

Around 30 September 2022, an unidentified armed group killed the village head of Bengo whom they had abducted from his residence [coded separately]. Location coded to Bagale Hills (Girei, Adamawa) where the victim's body was picked up by his relatives, the abductors killed him after collecting 2 million naira which they claimed was too little as ransom and abducted the person who delivered it.

Around 30 September 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a man who went to deliver ransom that was demanded for the release of the village head of Bengo. Location coded to Bengo (Fufore, Adamawa) where the village head was abducted from. The abductors insisted on 15 million as ransom for the village head after 2 million was taken to them and abducted the delivery man instead. The decomposing body of the delivery man was found [coded separately] on 16 October.
On 1 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted 6 people from Zarummai town (Bukkuyum, Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 1 October 2022, a local self defense that tried to foil an abduction clashed with a Niger militia at Ajiji-Kapako (Lapai, Niger). The assailants wounded one member of the defense militia and abducted three farmers.
On 1 October 2022, a policeman stabbed and killed his colleague over a misunderstanding in Birnin Kebbi (Birnin-Kebbi, Kebbi).

On 1 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted the traditional ruler of Owa Onire community, his wife and driver around Oba-Isin, coded to Share (Ifelodun, Kwara). The wife was rescued by policemen who also claimed to have arrested two persons in connection with the abduction, other sources report that the abductees were abducted in Owa Onire town.

On 2 October 2022, a Niger militia abducted 12 farmers from Unguwan Yusuf in Kpada ward (Lapai, Niger). An unspecified number of abductees escaped, there are no reports on ransom demands for the remaining.

On 2 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a man from Kwanar Dangora village in Bebeji LGA (Kano). A ransom of 30 million which was later reduced to 1.030 million naira was demanded. The abductee's decaying body was found on 9 October after the ransom amount was paid.
On 2 October 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked members of the APC during a ward meeting in Akpugo (Nkanu East, Enugu). One vehicle was burnt, casualties are unknown.

On 3 October 2022, an unidentified armed group killed a man from Akpata community in Awoye (Ilaje, Ondo). The reason for the attack is unknown, some sources report that the victim was spotted at a hotel, and later his body was found with his wrists, legs and waist bound with heavy objects. Locals of the community fled due to fear of reprisals.

On 3 October 2022, a local self defense militia clashed with an unidentified armed group at Dogoruwa in Bali LGA (Taraba) and killed 12 of them. The armed group was chased from neighboring Gassol LGA. Other sources report that an unidentified armed group dressed up as a local defense militia; killed 12 civilians at Mubizen, rustled 130 cattle, stole several motorcycles and food supplies; four of the assailants were arrested by the police and 8 to 50 other residents were declared missing.
On 3 October 2022, a Katsina militia wounded an unspecified number of persons and abducted others in Makera village (Dutsinma, Katsina).

On 3 October 2022, two unidentified rival cult militias clashed over a stolen motorcycle in Obudu town (Obudu, Cross River). The clash continued overnight and 6 persons were killed. The police claimed that 2 persons were killed.
On 3 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot sporadically when they invaded Daika community in Mangu LGA (Plateau) and abducted the community leader. There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 3 October 2022, a Katsina militia attacked civilians in Kuki B village (Dutsinma, Katsina) and wounded one person. An unspecified number of cattle were rustled.

On 4 October 2022, soldiers suspected to be part of the Ebonyi state governor's security detail flogged civil servants and other workers at the site of the ongoing airport in Onueke (Ezza South, Ebonyi) on the orders of the governor for resuming work late. The state government denied the reports and claimed that the person who were flogged were a mob who were trying to enforce a sit-in order.

On 4 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted three teenage Fulani boys and stole some rams from Gwanda in Gurdi ward (Abaji, FCT). The abductees escaped on 6 October after their abductors slept off.

On 4 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a woman, her son and grand-son at Abaji (Abaji, FCT) while they were returning to Abuja from Osun. A ransom of 50 million naira was demanded, the abductees were released on 7 October after a ransom of 2.350 million naira was paid, the woman's son who was a surveyor was murdered [coded separately].
On 4 October 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants abducted at least two civilians in the vicinity of Dusuman (Jere, Borno). There are no further details.

Around 5 October 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group abducted and killed a community leader from Ora, whose decomposing body was found in Akisa forest (Ifedayo, Osun). Four persons were arrested in connection to the attack.
On 5 October 2022, a Zamfara militia killed a boy when they invaded Birnin Tudu (Gummi, Zamfara). The victim was killed for refusing to take the assailants to houses that had cattle.

On 5 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted two female NYSC members from Zomo community, coded to Tunkus (Mikang, Plateau). One of the abductees escaped, a ransom of 25 million naira was demanded.
On 5 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted 27 civilians from Dan-Zamau, Gargaji and Maikulki villages, coded to Bukuyum (Bukkuyum, Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 5 October 2022, a Zamfara militia attacked and shot sporadically at residents of Birnin Waje coded to Bukuyum (Bukkuyum, Zamfara). 26 to 38 residents including women and children drowned as they were fleeing in canoes from the assailants who shot at them while they were in the canoes.

On 5 October 2022, an unidentified armed group comprised of pastoralists killed a soldier who responded to a distress call in Gagiya community Guri LGA (Jigawa). The assailants encroached into a farmland and the killed soldier who tried to prevent a fight between pastoralists and farmers; he was shot with a bow and arrow after with he was cut with a machete his rifle was stolen by the assailants.

On 5 October 2022, troops of Operation Hadin Kai clashed with a Zamfara militia that had attempted to attack a military base in Faru, Faru Magami ward, location coded to known village on the ward, Magami Diddi (Maradun, Zamfara). Scores of militiamen were killed, coded as 20, many of them sustained degrees of injuries and two civilians were killed by stray bullets.
On 5 October 2022, a Sokoto militia killed a clergyman on a farm along Isa-Sabon Birni road (Isa, Sokoto).

On 5 October 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to be assassins shot at the traditional ruler of Tarakiri an attempted to kill him on the road between Uduophori and Odorubu (Patani, Delta). There were no fatalities.

On 5 October 2022, over 500 KSVS operatives and hunters invaded the factory of Dangote cement company at Obajana (Lokoja, Kogi) and killed at least 7 staff. Several other staff members were injured, the operatives who were acting on the order of the state governor to shut down the company wielded different kinds of weapons.
On 5 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a nurse in front of a patent store which she runs in Agbani (Nkanu West, Enugu). There are no reports about ransom demands.

Around 6 October 2022 (as reported), the Defense Headquarters claimed that soldiers responded to a distress call and clashed with a Benue militia at Zaki Biam and Zamkara (Ukum, Benue). Three militiamen were arrested, two guns, ammunition, two phones and one motorcycle were recovered.

Around 6 October 2022 (as reported), troops of Operation Whirl Stroke invaded a hideout and clashed with an unidentified armed group at Otukpa community (Ogbadibo, Benue). Two members of the armed group were killed, while others escaped with gunshot wounds.

Around 6 October 2022 (as reported), the Defense Headquarters claimed to have raided a hideout and clashed with an unidentified armed group in Awe LGA (Nassarawa). Two members of the armed group were killed; guns, one motorcycle and mobile phones were recovered.

On 6 October 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked and shot at the FCT joint task force that was enforcing a motorcycle ban along the corridor of Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport (Abuja Municipal, FCT). The assailants also attacked the task force with other weapons, casualties are unknown.

On 6 October 2022, ISWAP fighters ambushed 12 Boko Haram [JAS] fighters and engaged them in an armed clash at Kirinowa (Marte, Borno). The Boko Haram fighters were returning with a large quantity of weapons which they had received from another Boko Haram camp; the ammunition was seized by ISWAP, eight fighters were killed, three others returned to the camp wounded and one was missing or assumed killed.

On 6 October 2022, an unidentified cult militia shot and killed a man on the premises of the Kwara state college of education Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). Other sources report that the victim was not a student of the school, but ran into the premises while he was being chased by the assailants.

On 6 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot and killed a man whom they abducted at Abaji (Abaji, FCT) while he was returning to Abuja from Osun alongside his mother and son [coded separately]. The victim was killed after the abductors accused him of trying to fight them, his mother and son were released after a ransom was paid.

On 6 October 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants shot at a commercial vehicle that refused to stop at an illegal vehicle checkpoint which they set up in the vicinity of Jigalta (Nganzai, Borno). There were no casualties.

Around 7 October 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group killed a man whom they abducted on 2 October [coded separately]. The victim's body was found at Badafi ward (Kiru, Kano). The abductors collected a ransom of 1.030 million naira before informing the victim's relatives that he had been killed.

On 7 October 2022, a Niger militia abducted 16 farmers while they were working on their farms at Kache village in Lapai LGA (Niger). Four of the abductees escaped from the abductors' camp, a ransom of 16 million naira was demanded for the remaining abductees. Other sources report that 15 abductees were released after 16 million naira and some foodstuff was paid as ransom, one of the abductees was murdered when he attempted to escaped.

On 7 October 2022, a Katsina militia blocked the road and abducted an unspecified number of travelers a few kilometers away from Yankara community (Faskari, Katsina). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 7 October 2022, an unidentified armed group invaded the residence of a business woman, killed her son and abducted her daughter at Alagbado area in Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). The assailants did not find the woman who was their target before they abducted her daughter, a ransom of 100 million was demanded. The abductee was released on 10 October after 5 million naira was paid as ransom.
On 7 October 2022, a Zamfara militia attacked civilians at Gesawa, Gabaken Mesaand Gabaken Danmiliki in Kaura Namoda LGA (Zamfara). One person was killed and cattle were rustled.

On 7 October 2022, suspected members of ESN/ IPOB attacked and disarmed members of the Neighborhood Watch in Nkerefi (Nkanu East, Enugu). Other sources reported that the militants visited each local defense militia operative and made them surrender their weapons. There were no casualties.

On 8 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted 13 persons from Masama-Mudi village (Bukkuyum, Zamfara) when they invaded the area. The abductees consisted of 8 nursing mothers, four teenage boys and the son of a farmer who resisted the demand of the militiamen to be shown the houses of rich community members, one baby was dropped on the floor while the mother was abducted.
On 8 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a commercial driver and 8 of his passengers along Emohua-Kalabari road (Emohua, Rivers). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 8 October 2022, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists attacked civilians and killed at least 10 persons at Gidan Sule in Keana LGA (Nassarawa). The assailants shot sporadically, killed 5 people on the spot, while 5 other bodies were discovered the following day; scores of persons escaped with gunshot wounds, several others including women, children and old persons were missing.

Around 8 October 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group killed a man from Kwanar Dangora village and left the body in Bebeji LGA (Kano). The man had been abducted on 2 October 2022 (coded separately) and killed after a ransom was paid.

On 8 October 2022, an unidentified armed group numbering 10 and dressed in military camouflage abducted four farmers at the agric settlement in Iseyin (Iseyin, Oyo). The persons who escaped the abduction fled towards Okeho, security operatives conducted a search and rescue operation in the area. The body of one of the abductees was found on 10 October. The abductees were released on 14 October after 10 million naira was paid as ransom.

On 8 October 2022, an unidentified armed group killed a man at Unadu community (Igbo Eze South, Enugu). The victim was a former councilor and APC youth leader in Igbo Eze LGA, other sources report that he was also the chairman of the vigilante group in his community, he as shot on his motorcycle and the passenger he was carrying was unharmed.

On 8 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot at policemen who arrested their colleague at Anagada community (Gwagwalada, FCT). One civilian was killed by a stray bullet, the assailants fled into the bush.

On 8 October 2022, a presumed Katsina militia attacked civilians traveling along Funtua-Gusau road (Funtua, Katsina), shot one person and abducted another. The wounded victim later died in the hospital.
On 8 October 2022, an unidentified armed group in their dozens attacked civilians in Kulias village, Bokkos LGA (Plateau). Four persons including two village heads were killed.

On 8 October 2022, troops of Operation Hadin Kai who were on a long range patrol killed two Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants in the axis of Firgi in Gwoza LGA (Borno). The troops intercepted the militants on motorcycles and instantly killed them.

On 9 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted the district head of Iyaka community from his residence in Gummi LGA (Zamfara). The abductors parked their motorcycles and walked into the village, there are no reports about ransom demands.

On 9 October 2022, an unidentified armed group numbering six attacked a police station at Inyi (Oji River, Enugu). One on-duty policeman and one civilian who was at the station to lodge a complaint were killed, the police station was set ablaze. Other sources report that the assailants were chanting 'no election and police in Biafra land' and the two fatalities were policemen. IPOB denied responsibility for the attack and accused the Nigerian army of linking the group to the attack out of hatred.

On 9 October 2022, an unidentified armed group clashed with policemen when they invaded a quarry owned by Chinese nationals in Zuba (Gwagwalada, FCT). One policeman was killed, another one whom they attempted to abduct was abandoned with gunshot wounds.

On 9 October 2022, an unidentified armed group dressed in military camouflage attacked policemen who were on a stop and search duty at Umuna, coded to Okigwi (Okigwe, Imo). Two policemen were killed, one was wounded by the assailants who drove army Hilux vehicles.
On 9 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot and killed four soldiers at Iyiachi community, coded to Oji River Settlement (Oji River, Enugu).
On 9 October 2022, a faction of an unidentified cult militia killed a member of a rival faction at Mile two Diobu (Port Harcourt, Rivers).
On 9 October 2022, a Katsina militia abducted one person from Project quarters in Funtua (Funtua, Katsina). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 9 October 2022, an unidentified armed group on motorcycles disarmed policemen at a mining site at Iboko (Izzi, Ebonyi) and killed one Chinese expatriate whom the policemen were protecting.
On 9 October 2022, a Fulani militia killed four civilians when they attacked Batura community (Bokkos, Plateau).

Around 10 October 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group killed one of the farmers that were abducted from Iseyin (Iseyin, Oyo) [coded separately]. The body of the victim was dumped by the assailants at a settlement. Other sources report that the victim was killed when the abductors clashed with security agents who were trying to rescue the abductees.

Around 10 October 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group killed a lecturer whom they abducted after he went to deliver ransom for another abductee [coded separately]. The victim was killed after a ransom of 7 million naira was paid and his decomposing body was found on 15 October at the foot of Bagale hills (Girei, Adamawa).

Around 10 October 2022 (as reported), a Niger militia killed one farmer who was among 16 others that were abducted from Kache community in Lapai LGA (Niger) [coded separately]. The victim was shot when he attempted to escape after untying himself.

On 10 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted one civilian and took his car from his residence at Agbarho (Ughelli North, Delta). The victim was rescued by the police after the abductors abandoned him and the car following a chase by policemen who responded to the distress call.

On 10 October 2022, policemen engaged an unidentified armed group numbering over 20 in an armed clash at Ebiaji (Ezza North, Ebonyi) when the assailants set a section of the local government secretariat ablaze. New air conditioners, some documents, a generating set and furniture were burnt, some of the assailants were wounded before they fled.

On 10 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot and killed a man who was riding on a motorcycle with his wife. The attack was over a land dispute between Umuebu and Amai, location coded to Umuebu (Ukwuani, Delta).

On 10 October 2022, an unidentified cult militia killed a boy at Ago-Okota, coded to Oshodi (Oshodi, Lagos). The victim was murdered in his father's residence, his hands were tied and his throat was slit. The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 10 October 2022, ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants ambushed Nigerian troops who were on a patrol at the Kumshe-Banki axis (Bama, Borno) and detonated an IED. The troops repelled the attack and killed about two dozens of militants, some others fled with gunshot wounds; a few soldiers were wounded and one patrol vehicle was destroyed.

On 10 October 2022, suspected Fulani pastoralists beat one civilian, killed him and wounded one other person in Jol community (Riyom, Plateau). The wounded person was taken to the hospital, the attack was as a result of a disagreement over grazing.

On 11 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted over 20 civilians when they invaded Birnin Tudu (Gummi, Zamfara). The assailants also broke into many shops and stole properties. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 11 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot a commercial driver on the foot and hijacked his bus with passengers in it at the Omerelu axis (Emohua, Rivers). The driver was rescued and taken to a hospital while the passengers were abducted, the victims were en route Port Harcourt from Owerri.

On 11 October 2022, members of unidentified cult militia numbering about 50 and armed with different types of weapons attacked and robbed passers-by and shop owners and wounded an unspecified number of persons at Eagle Island, Timber and Echue coded to Diobu (Port Harcourt, Rivers). The assailants were searching for rival members who attacked their colleague [coded separately].

On 11 October 2022, ISWAP fighters ambushed Nigerian troops and Civilian JTF operatives who were on a fighting patrol in Gamboru (Ngala, Borno) and detonated an explosive device. 19 militants were killed and two persons on the side of the troops were wounded in the armed clash which lasted about 40 minutes, 9 motorcycles, multiple weapons and ammunition were recovered.

On 11 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted an off-duty policeman in Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). The abductee was taken away while he was about to enter his house after the close of work, there are no reports about ransom demands. The abductee was rescued by policemen, hunters and a local self defense militia on 16 October, there are no reports of a clash.

On 11 October 2022, an unidentified armed group set a car ablaze and abducted the driver at Akokwa (Ideato North, Imo). The abductors shot severally at the car and set it ablaze, then shot continuously in the air while driving away.

On 11 October 2022, a Katsina militia killed an unspecified number of persons, wounded others and rustled cattle at Tsako village, coded to Dutsin Ma (Dutsinma, Katsina). Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 11 October 2022, an unidentified armed group who barricaded a road clashed with policemen that were on routine patrol in Du (Jos South, Plateau). One of the assailants was killed and the others fled with varying degrees of bullet wounds, one rifle was recovered.

On 12 October 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked and killed a medical doctor at Ichi Girls Bust stop in Ekwusigwo LGA (Anambra) coded to Ekwusigo. The victim was shot in his car, the reason for the attack is unknown.

On 12 October 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked an operative of the police So Safe corps with a machete and wounded him at Anifowose community (Ifo, Ogun). The operatives had trailed the assailants who 10 in number when they stopped and attacked one operative. One motorcycle and a locally made gun were recovered by the operatives while the assailants fled.

On 12 October 2022, an suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked farmers who were working on their farms and killed 5 of them at Yelwata community, coded to Gbajimba (Guma, Benue). 4 to 6 other victims sustained varying degrees of machete inflicted wounds.
On 12 October 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked at Gana Street in Maitama (Abuja Municipal, Federal Capital Territory) killing 1 civilian and abducting another.

On 12 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot and killed one Ebube Agu operative at Umuezeaka (Ezza North, Ebonyi). The operatives were standing by the roadside when the assailants who operated on a motorcycle shot at them and fled.

On 12 October 2022, policemen intercepted a large number of members of a Kaduna militia at Idasu (Giwa, Kaduna) and killed two militiamen. Other militiamen fled with bullet wounds, one abductee was rescued, one motorcycle and 24 rounds of ammunition were recovered.

On 12 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a man along Dutse-Kiyawa road (Dutse, Jigawa). The abductee was found unconscious at Suletankara LGA on 13 October and had been abducted after he withdrew 800 thousand naira from a bank, after gaining consciousness, he claimed that he was forced to inhale a substance which led him to lose consciousness.
On 12 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a catholic priest who was returning home from Umunnachi, coded to Abagana (Njikoka, Anambra). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 12 October 2022, a Zamfara militia attacked commuters along Kaura Namoda-Shinkafi road (Kaura Namoda, Zamfara). Four people were killed and four others were wounded.

On 12 October 2022, a Sokoto militia killed a member of a local self defense militia, abducted the son of a state lawmaker and wounded one other person when they invaded Rimawa village (Goronyo, Sokoto). The assailants invaded the area on motorcycles each of which carried 3 armed men.

On 12 October 2022, policemen responded to a distress call and clashed with a Katsina militia at Gidan Baushe, Gatakawa (Kankara, Katsina). 18 persons that the assailants abducted were rescued, 5 motorcycles and 2 cows were recovered; many militiamen were assumed killed while others fled with bullet wounds. Two civilians were killed and one was wounded before the arrival of the police, unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 12 October 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked 3 members of a local self defense militia who were drinking at a pub in Igbo-Ukwu community (Aguata, Anambra) and killed them. Some sources report that the assailants were members of a kidnap syndicate who killed the victims because they curtailed their activities, other sources report that the assailants were members of a separatist group that considered the victims to be Ebube Agu operatives and their rivals.

On 13 October 2022, suspected Fulani pastoralists invaded Obeagu community (Agwu, Ebonyi) and left two persons seriously injured. An unspecified number of persons were abducted by the assailants who laid siege on the road and attacked residents returning to the community from the town. Other sources report one killed and two others abducted.
On 13 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted two persons when they attacked Birnin Zauma (Bukkuyum, Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 13 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted eight persons when they attacked Jakaba in Maru LGA (Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 13 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot at the car of a former lawmaker and abducted him at an abandoned security checkpoint in Awka (Awka South, Anambra). Other sources report that one unidentified person was also abducted, the abductees cars were found riddled with bullet holes. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 13 October 2022, Nigerian troops clashed with a Zamfara militia that was led by Bada in Yar Tashar village in Maru LGA (Zamfara). The militiamen had killed an unspecified number of farmers, coded as 3, the militia leader was killed by the troops. Fatalities coded as 4.

On 13 October 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants abducted an unspecified number of commuters and robbed them of their valuables at an illegal vehicle checkpoint which they mounted in the vicinity of Kulu Keweya, coded to Gajiram (Nganzai, Borno). two of the abductees were released to inform relatives that a ransom of 500 thousand naira had been demanded for each abductee.
On 14 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted 20 people when they invaded 3 communities in (Bukkuyum, Zamfara) coded to Bukuyum. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 14 October 2022, an unidentified armed group shot at Ebube Agu operatives at a roadblock along Hausa quarters in Abakaliki (Abakaliki, Ebonyi). The attack resulted from the seizure of a motorcycle and the demand by the operatives for the owner to pay for its release. One operative was shot in the stomach, it is unclear if he died.

On 14 October 2022, an unidentified armed group attacked the PDP gubernatorial candidate and his supporters as they were entering Gusau (Gusau, Zamfara). One of the supporters was killed and several others were wounded. The PDP claimed that the assailants were sponsored by the state government, and that 18 environmental workers were attacked, one of whom was killed. The APC denied involvement in the attack, claimed that the assailants were hired by the PDP, insisted that the party disobeyed the executive order which banned political campaigns due to insecurity and that the victims 18 of who were wounded and one killed were workers on duty.

On 14 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted four civilians when they invaded Kuraje village in Gusau LGA (Gusau, Zamfara) in large numbers. The abductees which included a one year old child, were taken to Munhaye forest in Tsafe LGA and were rescued after 15 days by the police and local self defense militiamen [there are no reports of a clash].
On 14 October 2022, a Katsina militia killed one civilian when they attacked Kitibawa village (Dutsinma, Katsina) coded to Dutsin Ma.

Around 14 October 2022, (between 13 October - 15 October), Nigerian troops in collaboration with operatives from other security agencies clashed with IPOB militants at a suspected camp of the ESN in Amagunze (Nkanu East, Enugu). The troops dropped explosives, killed an unspecified number of persons and burned houses, civilians in the area fled. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 14 October 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants attacked soldiers guarding a humanitarian hub and engaged them in an armed clash at Monguno (Monguno, Borno). There are no further details.
On 14 October 2022, an unidentified armed group killed a woman at Mere village in Makera district (Riyom, Plateau). The victim's head was almost severed from her body.
On 14 October 2022, IPOB killed the traditional ruler of Obudi-Agwa (Oguta, Imo).

Around 15 October 2022 (as reported), a member of a Katsina militia attacked a farmer on his farm in Gobirawa community (Faskari, Katsina). The farmer overpowered the assailant, killed him and recovered his rifle which he submitted to the village head.

Around 15 October 2022 (as reported), a Katsina militia killed a farmer at Gobirawa community (Faskari, Katsina) in retaliation of the murder of their colleague by the victim [coded separately]. The militiamen also imposed a fine of 10 million naira on the community.

On 15 October 2022, policemen who were later reinforced by soldiers and a local self defense militia clashed an unidentified armed group along the east-west road at Emohua (Emohua, Rivers). The clash lasted nearly one hour, the police claimed that the assailants fled while other sources report that the police were unable to withstand the clash. Casualties are unknown.

On 15 October 2022, an unidentified cult militia attacked and killed a member of a rival group [assumed to be unarmed] around Abaku area in Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun). The assailants who were carrying sticks, machetes and charms hit the victim who died on the spot; other sources report that the police confirmed the report and claimed that the victim was on the watchlist of the anti-cultism of the state police command.

On 15 October 2022, a Katsina militia attacked civilians, killed two residents at Gidan Diyam and abducted two to three others in Dayi community (Malumfashi, Katsina). The abductees included a trader whose entrance gate was completely pulled down by the abductors and a health care worker, there are no reports about ransom demands. The body of one of the abductees was discovered along Yammama-Kaita road on 17 October.
On 15 October 2022, a former commander of OSPAC killed a youth leader for reporting the illegal oil bunkering activities of OSPAC. Location coded to Emohua (Emohua, Rivers).
On 15 October 2022, a policeman shot and killed his colleague in Umuahia (Umuahia North, Abia) following an argument. The details of the argument are unknown.

On 15 October 2022, two unidentified rival cult militias clashed at Gwarandok community, coded to Bukuru (Jos South, Plateau). One person was killed and five others were wounded, the police claimed that one person was killed and the other was critically wounded.
On 15 October 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants abducted three persons in Shani LGA (Borno). The abductees were rescued by hunters [no report of a clash] who arrested one of the abductors.

On 15 October 2022, Nigerian troops of Operation Hadin Kai on patrol ambushed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants along Kumshe-Banki road (Bama, Borno). The air task force supported the troops with airstrikes which killed 6 militants while the others fled.

On 15 October 2022, an unidentified armed group killed four civilians and abducted the traditional ruler when they invaded Langai community (Mangu, Plateau). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 15 October 2022, a Katsina militia attacked civilians in Gidan Zaki, Malumfashi LGA (Malumfashi, Katsina). Three civilians were killed and valuables were stolen.

On 16 October 2022, suspected Ebube Agu operatives abducted a former House of Representatives member who is a LP senatorial candidate in the 2023 elections while he was on his way home in Abakaliki (Abakaliki, Ebonyi). The abductee's aide claimed he had been tortured and naked pictures of him were taken by the abductors, Ebube Agu corps denied involvement in the incident.

On 16 October 2022, an unidentified armed group numbering 5 invaded a residence, hit a woman in the chest and abducted two of her children from Aseyori community, coded to Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). The abductors gained entrance into the house after they destroyed the door, they took away phones; 20 million naira, beverages, food and a replacement of the bullets fired during the attack were demanded as ransom. The abductees were released around 18 October after a ransom of 5 million naira was paid.

On 16 October 2022, the Defense Headquarters claimed that Nigerian troops on clearance operations clashed with ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants at Sawa village, coded to Gajiram (Nganzai, Borno). Four militants were killed and four rifles were recovered.

On 17 October 2022, a Zamfara militia engaged in an armed clash with a local self defense militia that attempted to repel an attack on their community in Birnin Tudu (Gummi, Zamfara). One local militia member was killed while the others fled.

On 17 October 2022, a Zamfara militia attacked a healthcare center and abducted a health worker in Birnin Magaji (Gummi, Zamfara). Medical and food supplies were destroyed, there are no reports about ransom demands.

On 17 October 2022, an unidentified armed group in their numbers attacked civilians at Nyalun village in Wase LGA (Plateau). Three persons including the village head were killed, five members of the village head's family were abducted and unspecified number of motorcycles belonging to residents were stolen.
On 17 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted ten women and one baby in Manya, coded to Anka LGA (Anka, Zamfara). The abductees were released on 21 October 2022.
On 17 October 2022, a Zamfara militia shot and wounded one person when they attacked Kuraje village in Gusau LGA (Gusau, Zamfara).
On 17 October 2022, a Zamfara militia mounted on motorcycles fired indiscriminately, abducted 9 persons and later killed one of the abductees in Unguwar Hayin Banki, Anka LGA (Anka, Zamfara).
Around 17 October 2022 (as reported), a Katsina militia killed a man who they had abducted [coded separately] and abandoned his body along Yammama-Kaita road (Malumfashi, Katsina).

On 17 October 2022, Nigerian troops repelled an attack by scores of ISWAP militants on Mafa town (Mafa, Borno). The militants who invaded the area in gun trucks and motorcycles, attempted to attack the town through Charly Papa 1 and fled after the troops engaged them. There were no casualties from the troops, unknown militant fatalities coded as 3. ISWAP claimed the attack and said a military checkpoint was attacked, the garrison was driven away and ammunition was taken away.
On 17 October 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants abducted one civilian at an illegal vehicle checkpoint in Madamari (Magumeri, Borno).

On 18 October 2022, a Kambari communal militia clashed with a Fulani militia over a land dispute in Salka (Magama, Niger). The clash started after an argument ensued, and a Kambari local was wounded by a Fulani. Two persons were killed, several houses including 30 huts belonging to pastoralists, the palace of the district head and a police station were set ablaze, security agents were deployed to broker peace.

On 18 October 2022, a Niger militia shot sporadically, killed two civilians and abducted over 20 other persons when they invaded a hospital in Gulu (Lapai, Niger) in their numbers. The abductees included health workers, their relatives, patients and the patients' relatives. The police claimed that two persons were killed and 8 others were abducted. There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 18 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a lecturer along Shabu area (Lafia, Nassarawa) while he was returning home from work. There are no reports about ransom demands, the abductee was released on 20 October, the police claimed that no ransom was paid.
On 18 October 2022, Boko Haram [JAS] militants abducted one person at an illegal vehicle checkpoint along Maiduguri-Gajiram road (Nganzai, Borno).
On 18 October 2022, a Katsina militia killed a man and abducted his daughter from a residence in Sabon Garin Bilbis in Faskari LGA (Faskari, Katsina).

On 19 October 2022, suspected members of an unidentified cult militia ambushed and killed two members of the disbanded OSPAC [assumed to be unarmed] in Ibaa (Emohua, Rivers). Other sources report that the attack was a reprisal for the death of their member.

On 19 October 2022, a Kaduna militia abducted one person along Birnin Gwari road (Birnin Gwari, Kaduna). The abductee was a student of Federal University Dutsinma, there are no reports about ransom demands.
On 19 October 2022, a Katsina militia attacked civilians in Barawa village (Batagarawa, Katsina). One farmer was killed, two persons were wounded and an unspecified number of others were abducted.
On 19 October 2022, a Zamfara militia attacked civilians in Gana community, coded to Bukuyum (Bukkuyum, Zamfara). An unspecified number of persons were wounded and abducted.

On 19 October 2022, troops of Operation Forest Sanity responded to a distress call and clashed with a Kaduna militia at Rafin Kaura, around Dende-Buruku junction (Chikun, Kaduna). The militiamen fled, their camp was cleared by the troops and two abductees were rescued.

On 19 October 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to be abductors ambushed a the convoy of the provost of federal college of education near the boundary of Isu (Onicha, Ebonyi) and Agba. The provost, his police orderly, two aides, driver and college librarian were in the same car; the librarian and driver were wounded while the others escaped and were later rescued by policemen. Other cars on the convoy fled back to Isu while the provost's car was looted and burned by the assailants.
On 19 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted one woman from her residence at Unguwar Yarima in Gusau (Gusau, Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 19 October 2022, troops of Operation Whirl Punch who were on a fighting patrol clashed with a Kaduna militia at Abasiya-Amale area of Kachia LGA (Kaduna). Two militiamen were killed, others were assumed to have fled with bullet wounds, their hideout was destroyed, one rifle and ammunition were recovered.
On 19 October 2022, a Katsina militia abducted 6 civilians from Yar Ruma village, coded to Dutsin Ma (Dutsinma, Katsina). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 19 October 2022, a Fulani militia on a reprisal attack clashed with police operatives when they attacked civilians in Gbeji community, coded to nearby Tsegbayer (Ukum, Benue). Two policemen and 16 civilians were killed, other sources report that one policeman and 17 civilians were killed.

On 20 October 2022, a Kaduna militia attacked commuters, wounded one and abducted several others within Birnin Yero ward (Igabi, Kaduna). Nigerian troops pursued the militiamen and they abandoned 5 abductees.
On 20 October 2022, a Zamfara militia killed two civilians when they attacked Gidan Dan Zarah village in Zurmi LGA (Zurmi, Zamfara).

On 20 October 2022, troops of Operation Hadarin Daji who were on a fighting patrol clashed with a Zamfara militia at Dorca village (Anka, Zamfara). Two militiamen including Ibrahim Chire who was a militia leader were killed, others fled with injuries. One rifle, 4 rounds of ammunition, one motorcycle and mobile phones were recovered.

On 20 October 2022, an unidentified armed group number about 10 invaded a mosque, killed one person and abducted two others in Saminaka area of Jalingo (Jalingo, Taraba). The abductees were a business man and his son, there are no reports about ransom demands.
Around 20 October 2022 (as reported), a Katsina militia abducted a businessman and killed him after collecting a ransom of 4 million naira in Kafur LGA (Kafur, Katsina).

On 20 October 2022, suspected Ebube Agu operatives attacked the Ebonyi state APGA gubernatorial candidate and his team at Iboko (Izzi, Ebonyi). The candidate claimed that their cars were riddled with bullets, there were no casualties in the attack and that he had received threats earlier that day and was warned to not visit the area, then Ebube Agu operatives shot at one of their cars, locked their office in Iboko and prevented them from accessing it. The chairman of Izzi LGA denied that any attack took place and claimed that it was the security operatives on the APGA candidate's convoy who attacked APC members in the area.

On 20 October 2022, the Nigeria Defense Headquarters claimed that IPOB militants attacked soldiers who were on duty and engaged them in an armed clash at Isuofia (Aguata, Anambra). The attack was repelled, one of the assailants was arrested by the troops who also recovered guns and ammunition.

On 21 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted 11 passengers of a commercial vehicle along the borders between Nassarawa and Benue state, coded to Keana (Keana, Nassarawa). The abductors demanded for a ransom of 50 million naira for each of the abductees.

On 21 October 2022, soldiers, policemen and a local self defense militia invaded militia camps and clashed with a Zamfara militia in Gando forest (Maru, Zamfara). 27 abductees were rescued, casualties are unknown.
On 21 October 2022, suspected armed Fulani pastoralists attacked a farming community at Gidan Ityotyev in Obi LGA (Obi, Nassarawa). Two persons were killed and one female member was wounded.
On 21 October 2022, an unidentified armed group killed one civilian and burned his motorcycle in Ukemberagya council ward, coded to Ugba (Logo, Benue).
On 21 October 2022, a Niger militia attacked civilians at Maijaki in Tashibo (Lapai, Niger), killed one person and abducted 13 others.

On 21 October 2022, a policeman shot and wounded a commercial motorcyclist who was dragging a rifle with his colleagues along Lagos-Ibadan expressway, coded to Ojodu Berger (Ifo, Ogun). The policeman fled from the scene.

On 21 October 2022, an unidentified armed group (described as bandits, coded as UAG) attacked custom operatives of the joint border patrol and engaged them in an armed clash along Sinau-Kenu road (Baruten, Kwara). One of the operatives was killed and three others sustained life threatening injuries.

On 21 October 2022, an unidentified armed group killed an off-duty policeman in his house at Onitsha Enugu, coded to Enugu-Ezike (Igbo Eze North, Enugu). The assailants forced their way into the victim's bedroom, shot him at close range and stole his money and mobile phone.

On 21 October 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to be assassins attacked the convoy of a pastor and killed 7 persons including 3 police orderlies near Auchi (Etsako West, Edo). Other sources report that one female aide of the pastor was abducted.
On 21 October 2022, a Katsina militia abducted nine civilians when they attacked Raddawa (Matazu, Katsina). There are no reports about ransom demands.
On 21 October 2022, ISWAP fighters led by Bako Gogore attacked a formation of Nigerian troops at Waijroko (Damboa, Borno). There are no further details.
On 22 October 2022, a Zamfara militia killed one civilian when they attacked Gwashi village (Bukkuyum, Zamfara).
On 22 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted two civilians when they attacked Tuza village in Mayana ward (Gusau, Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 22 October 2022, a joint patrol which comprised of soldiers and policemen clashed with a Katsina militia and repelled them along Jibia-Magama road (Jibia, Katsina). Two civilians were killed and three others were abducted by the assailants before they were repelled by the joint patrol.

On 22 October 2022, ISWAP fighters attacked the camp of Boko Haram [JAS] fighters whom they referred to as ''infidels'' and killed 6 of them at Gajibo (Dikwa, Borno). ISWAP seized 5 rifles in the attack.

On 22 October 2022, a local defense militia clashed with a Zamfara militia that invaded Gidan Gabi village in Wanke district (Gusau, Zamfara). The assailants killed one civilian, two of the assailants were killed by the local defense militia.

On 22 October 2022, a Sokoto militia attacked residents and shot at them in Mamman Suka (Gwadabawa, Sokoto). Two persons were killed and 13 others comprised of 11 females and two males were abducted during the attack which lasted for hours, some live stock were rustled, other valuables including money and phones were taken by the assailants.

On 23 October 2022, an unidentified armed group ambushed attacked three commuters at Tse Ikem, on the road between Chembe and Anyiin (Logo, Benue). The two men among the victims butchered and killed while the woman fled unharmed.

On 23 October 2022, soldiers of the Nigerian army shot and killed two civilians in Owode (Egbado South, Ogun) following an altercation over contraband goods, the soldiers fled the scene. Other sources report that one civilian was killed by the soldiers who also broke into shops in the markets and took away bags of rice before they fled.

On 23 October 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to consist of armed Fulani pastoralists abducted an unspecified number of commuters who were in over five vehicles along Ugwuogo-Nike-Opi-Nsukka (Nsukka, Enugu). A ransom of 30 million naira was demanded for the release of a woman and her son, the ransom demands for other abductees was not specified, other sources report that the ransom amounts of some abductees was increased after the abductors searched their phones to determine who they were.

On 23 October 2022, a joint team of policemen, soldiers and DSS operatives invaded a camp of IPOB militants and engaged them in an armed clash at Omege village in Agba community (Ishielu, Ebonyi). An unspecified number of militants were killed and many escaped with bullet wounds. Fatalities coded as 3.

On 23 October 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to have been sponsored by the APC attacked the convoy of the PDP gubernatorial candidate at Ikoga junction (Badagry, Lagos). The assailants who were armed with guns and other weapons wounded some party members and journalists, smashed windshields and windows of vehicles. The publicity secretary of the PDP gubernatorial campaign claimed the assailants were APC supporters who were chanting the party's name during the attack.
On 23 October 2022, a Katsina militia killed two residents in Katsina (Katsina, Katsina). The assailants fired indiscriminately and also abducted three other people.
On 23 October 2022, a Sokoto militia attacked civilians and fired indiscriminately at Kalugo (Binji, Sokoto). Two persons were killed and 8 others were abducted.

On 24 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a PDP candidate in the Benue house of assembly election and three others around Taraku Mills (Gwer East, Benue). The politician was released on 29 October after 3 million naira was paid as ransom.

On 24 October 2022, troops of the forward operating base Buratai of Operation Hadin Kai while on a long range patrol clashed with Boko Haram militants [JAS] in Sabon Garin Peshingo, code to Buratai (Biu, Borno). Some of the militants were killed and 4 motorcycles were recovered by the troops, unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 24 October 2022, troops of Operation Hadin Kai engaged Boko Haram militants [JAS] in an armed clash at Feshingo (Shani, Borno). An unspecified number of militants were killed, coded as 3, and 4 motorcycles were recovered.

On 24 October 2022, an armed Fulani pastoralist attacked a farmer and chopped off his hand with a machete on his farm at Rimba Ebagi (Abaji, FCT). The attack was a result of a disagreement over grazing on the victim's farm.

On 24 October 2022, the Nigerian Defense Headquarters claimed that soldiers and policemen on a fighting patrol clashed with suspected IPOB militants around Nkwerre-Inyi forest (Oji River, Enugu). The troops pursued the militants after they fled on sighting them, 2 SUV vehicles, 3 motorcycles and other items were recovered.
On 24 October 2022, a Zamfara militia abducted an unspecified number of persons from Rijiyar Tsakar Dawa in Gusau LGA (Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands.

On 24 October 2022, Boko Haram [JAS] fighters from Abu-Iklima's camp carried out reprisals and attacked camps of rival ISWAP fighters and engaged them in an armed clash at Bole and Yale (Konduga, Borno). The Boko Haram fighters killed scores of ISWAP fighters while others fled, recovered weapons, motorcycles, money and other items. ISWAP laid ambush for the Boko Haram fighters as they were returning and killed three of them.

On 24 October 2022, a naval officer led an unidentified armed group dressed in military camouflage suspected to be acting on behalf of APC party to abduct a former member of the APC who defected to the PDP, and also assaulted his wife from residence at Lugbe (Abuja Municipal, FCT). The PDP in Kogi state claimed that the naval officer involved is part of the special navy squad positioned at the residence of the state governor in Okene, the abductee's wife claimed that the she miscarried a pregnancy as a result of the assault.
On 24 October 2022, a Zamfara militia killed one person and abducted 4 others when they attacked civilians in Dunba (Gusau, Zamfara). The abductees included 3 females and 1 male.
Around 25 October 2022 (as reported), a Niger militia abducted 20 children from Kusheriki (Rafi, Niger). The abductees included 16 girls and 4 boys, a ransom of 40 million naira was demanded.

On 25 October 2022, a Zamfara militia attacked commuters and shot one person when they blocked the Magazu-Kucheri road (Tsafe, Zamfara). The wounded victim was in a vehicle whose driver refused to stop for the assailants.

On 25 October 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to be assassins killed a man with an axe at his home in Okuta Elerinla area of Akure (Akure South, Ondo). The victim's wife claimed that the attack was related to a disputed plot of land.
On 25 October 2022, Ezza and Effium communal militias clashed in Ohaukwu, coded to Effium (Ohaukwu, Ebonyi). There are no further details.
On 25 October 2022, an unidentified armed group with masked members abducted a motorist on Medical road in Ikeja (Ikeja, Lagos). There are no further details.

On 26 October 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted 16 passengers and the bus driver when they blocked the road along Ugbokolo and Okpoga (Okpokwu, Benue). A ransom of 500 million naira was demanded.

On 26 October 2022, a Kaduna militia abducted two civilians when they broke into a house at Hayin Mallam in Jama'a ward (Sabon Gari, Kaduna). The abductees were taken away after sporadic gunshots, other sources reports that a local self defense militia pursued the abductors who escaped, there are no reports about ransom demands.

On 26 October 2022, presumed ISWAP/ Boko Haram militants attacked a forward operating base and were engaged in an armed clash by the troops at Freetown, coded to nearby Banki (Bama, Borno). The militants withdrew, casualties are unknown.

On 27 October 2022, the Nigerian Defense Headquatters claimed that soldiers in collaboration with DSS operatives and policemen conducted a clearance operation on a camp of IPOB militants and engaged them in an armed clash at Orsumoghu (Ihiala, Anambra). 5 militants were killed and 2 others were arrested, weapons, ammunition, IEDs and military uniforms were recovered along with other items.

On 27 October 2022, six suspected IPOB militants attacked policemen who were on a stop and search duty and engaged them in an armed clash in Orlu (Orlu, Imo). One of the assailants was killed, guns, several rounds of ammunition and the car used in the attack which the police claim was stolen, were recovered.
On 27 October 2022, a Katsina militia killed two civilians at Bugaje village (Jibia, Katsina).

Around 27 October 2022 (as reported), a Niger militia abducted at least 30 locals from Kuchi (Muya, Niger). There are no reports about ransom demands; sources report that the militiamen were fueling their motorcycles from a burst pipeline at Sakpe.

On 27 October 2022, a Kaduna militia abducted six residents from Autan Kuli village in Yakawada ward (Giwa, Kaduna). The abductors shot sporadically into the air when they invaded the area, there are no reports about ransom demands.

On 27 October 2022, an unidentified armed group suspected to consist of armed Fulani pastoralists shot at commuters and wounded one person along Enugu-Ugwuogo Nike-Nsukka road (Nsukka, Enugu). A former secretary to the Enugu state government and several others were abducted, there are no reports about ransom demands. Other sources report that the attack happened near a police checkpoint by Ekwuegbe in Igbo-Etiti.
On 27 October 2022, a Katsina militia killed one person when they attacked civilians in Gerke village, Batagarawa LGA (Katsina). Two persons sustained gunshot wounds.

Around 27 October 2022 (between 20 October - 3 November), the Defense Headquarters claimed that Nigerian troops engaged an unidentified armed group whose hideout was invaded on the Takum-Wukari road (Takum, Taraba). Scores of armed persons were killed, items including cash, charms, phones and an ID card were recovered.

Around 28 October 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group shot and killed a pastoralist in Akwukwu-Igbo (Oshimili North, Delta). The assailants also killed three cattle and buried the victim in a shallow grave before they fled. The reason for the attack is unknown, some sources report that a warning was previously issued to pastoralists to flee the area.

On 28 October 2022, NSCDC operatives numbering 6 shot and killed 3 youths in Adiegbe community, coded to Ekeremor (Ekermor, Bayelsa) over their involvement in oil bunkering, as claimed by the community's leaders, who added that the assailants were attached to Tompolo's private security company. The NSCDC claimed that its patrol team was attacked by an unidentified armed group with which they engaged in an armed clash.

On 28 October 2022, a Tarbuwa militia attacked civilians from Kubdiya community who were passing in a caravan through Tarbuwa (Zaki, Bauchi). The victims were attacked with machetes and escaped with cuts, others sources report that one person was wounded and his motorcycle was set ablaze.

On 28 October 2022, a Zamfara militia led by Gwaska Dankarami simultaneously invaded two residences and abducted two persons in Dauran Birnin Tsaba (Zurmi, Zamfara). The abductees were a district head and an APC chieftain, the militia leader called the abductees' relatives to confirm the abduction which he claimed was a reprisal for the seizure of his motorcycles by security operatives. There are no reports about ransom demands.
